text: It's a game that is designed to occupy your time and I'm not mad about that. But the constant "micro" transaction push is irritating, you get the impression that nothing is random. It feels like the game pushes situations that require purchases to progress. I'm not surprised by this, but new users should be aware, like most similar games, once you justify the cost once you'll justify it every time. Don't start that cycle. Plus the storyline progresses so slowly and is a bit bland

I will start with the positives. Great story, cute characters, nice challenges. Negative one and most important! Can't progress into the story unless you spend money to buy energy. The more bundles you buy the more expensive they get. It started off with 0.99p but now it has become so expensive! I will uninstall the game altogether as it is very tempting to spend more! Beware, it can lead u to empty your pockets without even realising it...

just don't see the point of playing. From the beginning it was fun. More levels you going up its getting ridiculously long to finish the requirements. Without paying the real money for an extra diamonds or energy, the game its worthless. There are some events to get extra boos of energy or diamonds, but the game gets very very very boring when you can't get eny progress in a days. So will uninstall it, its not worth paying any real money.

First off, be warned. Actual gameplay is nothing like the ads. That said, it was fun for the first month or so. After that unless you want to spend money then sometimes you'll only get about 10 mins gameplay per day. I've moved on. New comment. So much for improving the honesty of the ads. They now show gameplay from everyone else's games and ABSOLUTELY NO GAMEPLAY from your game. They've also added "completely free". Well that's another lie. Knocked you another star off. Sack your ad men.

I really enjoy this game, and if I were only rating the game play itself it would be a 5. However, as you progress in the game the energy requirements become ridiculous. Higher level items can easily take 3000+ energy to achieve and you can't earn enough energy in a day to complete that one task. The only way to continue to progress is to purchase in game items. The ads call it a free game, but it's really not.

Extortionate! The more you play the more the packs cost and there's no reward for loyalty. I've spent over £1000 and my reward is to pay even more for the next pack. My husband has the same game, he doesn't spend much. It costs him £3.99 for the exact same pack it cost me £18.99. That's my reward. The Devs are incredibly greedy. I will no longer put any money into this game. I still can't complete events even after paying. I DO NOT RECOMMEND. Play Merge Restyle instead. it costs 1 energy.

After being flooded by ads for this game and how it has no ads and is exactly "as advertised", I wanted to check it out. And yes, true, there are no ads. In an age of being bombarded by ads every two minutes, it's a relief. But it is NOT what the ads claim the game to be lmao. It's yet another energy-based merger game that you play for like 5 minutes until you used up your energy, then leave until it refilled. And it grows old real quick. :/ Graphics are cute though, so that's nice.

Addictive and expensive. It's lots of fun with special events where you can win coins, lives, gems and items. But the higher up the levels you go, the harder it is to progress. Some items use 1000+lives and 100 free lives take hours to build. The only way to enjoy it at all it is to pay. I swore never to pay for games but was so frustrated that l caved and spent £40 in one month. So annoying because it is a great game. As a result, you either have to be incredibly frustrated

its not what it's advertised as at all. it's the same patterns over and over. the airline is on but it's not what they show. And it's not free. and I never got the introduction bundle even though I used their link. I have bought credits after credits hoping for something didn't each time. I keep seeing ads for this game that do not match the download. the ads look more fun.

Edit May 26, What are you doing? The app is changing, it's no longer possible to watch an ad to get a chest, rubies are very far and few between, I get less items from special chests, and it no longer has a good balance of extra events/puzzles/missions/. I now need to dismiss SO many at start-up. Old-this game has kept me entertained for a good while. The storyline is fun and interesting. The daily and weekly goals and prizes keep it moving, and the special event rotations keep it fresh

the game is easy enough to play, however as you progress through the levels it will take you days to complete some of the orders, unless you buy gems, than you can refill your energy. energy takes forever to refill to 100. 9/10 sticker packs always contain stickers you already have, so completing the sticker sets is hard. you can play offline which is great I guess.

I really enjoyed Gossip Harbour at first, but the pricing system has ruined it for me. Every time I made a purchase, the next offers became more expensive instead of rewarding loyal players. I contacted support last month, and nothing changed. Prices are now even higher. New players should be aware that spending money seems to increase future costs. It’s disappointing because the game itself is fun, but the monetisation feels unfair.

very addictive game to start with. then to keep it fun, and to actually compete in events and win meaningful prizes, you have to spend money otherwise it's impossible. and the prices keep rising and rising the more you play, and most the time the pricing makes no sense. I'd keep playing if it stayed at micro purchases, but £20-30 a time, no chance.

A very creative game despite the advert it uses. Very addicting but as you go higher it takes a long time to complete because the energy doesn't refill past 100 and 100 isn't enough for anything. I feel like the energy bar should have adapted too. I understand that there are the options of purchasing gems to buy energy which I do, but after putting money down to get 100-200 energy just to still not complete an order you start to feel a certain way.

The game is pretty good and I like that there aren't any adds but they make it virtually impossible to achieve any real progression unless you spend money. The energy that you build up is barely enough to complete orders for one customer, and even when you spend money it doesn't seem to go far. Also, some items don't produce enough of what you need, you can click the drinks thing and get a full board of coffee and only 2 teas, so it's pretty frustrating. Cute game but VERY slow progression.

Great to play for a couple of weeks, but then gets impossible. Competitive elements are essentially a battle of wallets. I've reached a point in this game where 1 order will take me days to have enough energy for, and I have made purchases, too! So I'm fed up, now. It's a real shame, because I was really enjoying it, hence actually spending a bit of money (something I rarely do on a game). I just feel like it's greedily created to become impossible to play for free after a short amount of time.

A really fun game but wants money and is happy to sacrifice gameplay for it. To play without paying, you can expect to only get 5-10 minutes of gameplay every 3 hours, especially once you have levelled up, which doesn't feel enough for my tastes. I would rather have more ad options to earn points but once you have levelled up even the 15 energy you get goes in about 10 seconds. that being said, playing is fun and simple to follow.

not happy at all. I kept an eye on this game with its adds. Completely false advertising! I enjoyed playing on the ads much more than the actual game. If the game was exactly like the ads show, I would have been stuck to it like glue. With all the different types of small games. Why do you lie straight to one's face!? No blizzards anywhere. Highly disappointed. Too little energy to fill orders, it becomes boring after level 10 is reached. I would have liked to finish the story..... :(

Ironic that the game running ads about other games not being what they claim, is not the game it's ads claim. This game is nothing but microtransactions. You can play for about 5 minutes before you need to buy more energy to continue. The story is awful. Leveling up is severely throttled unless you spend money. Overall a hot mess of a scam. Don't waste your time.

Before I rate a game I like to play it longer so that I can give a good review. The energy levels deplete very fast and this is pushing me to go look at other games now. We can't all afford to add money to games but when the opportunity comes you want to see that it will be worth it. 100 energy finishes fast and there are tasks I want to win but they are unreasonable. I think by next month I'll be deleting even though I like it a lot

I LOVE this merge game. It doesn't require emptying energy to get rare items, and I especially appreciate the generosity of regularly occurring rewarded energy. I would love it even more if there was the option to permanently turn off the conversations, not just skip every time they pop op. Still, this game is definitely my #1 favorite merge game, and I can easily say I have more than a lot of them on my electronics. 😏😁

Although this game is definitely less money grabbing than many others, it becomes relentless dull pretty quickly unless you are prepared to cough up some hard cold cash... if you dont spend your money, the game is slower than a snail. Additionally there are a vast number of side games which aren't fun and make no sense at all.

Love this game. The design is cute, the story is fun, and the merging is both super addictive and oh so satisfying. The only problem is that you can't upgrade the energy cap to refill itself past 100, so orders that cost more energy can take forever. I strongly recommend stocking up on gems, maxed-out energy potions, and also "gifts" for the characters. Also, make sure to max out any reward boxes you get before opening them and spring for the vip option for the seasonal rewards minigame.

It starts off fun but gets slow fast. It takes way too much energy to make your merge items. I am at lvl 17 and cant do much. The energy takes forever to refill, and their really isn't any way to get more unless you spend real $$$. And you get very little coins to continue the story. This is definitely only a few minutes of game play game and a money grabber type of game. Prizes, rewards, and merge items should advance with you.

Design of it would be a 4*. The advertising for it was definitely misscomunicated. You really don't do any of the survival puzzles it kept showing.I've been playing for 2 months now, and I haven't been able to complete any of the side quests because they don't give you enough energy to last through making big orders and the time they give you to complete the side missions isn't enough to even get halfway through. It feels rigged so that you have to spend your own $$ to get anywhere in the game.

I love the story lines and the mini games. A couple of months ago I would have rated this as a 5+. HOWEVER, as much as I hate to, I'm going to have to delete the app. It's to the point where it takes several hundred energies to fulfill just 1 order. Rarely can I play any of the mini games because they are over before I can fulfill enough orders to play. I really wish they would lower the energies so I could continue. I played daily and made several purchases monthly.

It's a major pay to play/win when it comes down to the races and events both against "other people" and on general. Repetitive orders that require way too much energy to make. I usually drop some money when it's a good game to help support the devs, and I'm not saying it isn't - but there's not enough energy to keep me wanting to come back more and continuously play. It has a lot of potential built-in and aesthetically it's nice... but greed overruns the fun, in my opinion.

The gameplay and storyline are decent, and I do enjoy the game for relaxing, but it's definitely a pay to win game, even moreso now. The game used to allow you to watch an ad to get small items for free or to get a little free energy, but all ad based rewards are gone now. So, you can wait a minute and a half for a single energy to generate, or you can pay for more energy. The energy you can buy has no cap, but earned energy caps at 100.

At some point, having to spend over 400 energy to fill just one order just isn't enough to keep your interest. Having to play 5 times a day at specific intervals because I'm not an idiot who will spend tons of money for a virtual 'commodity' is also not a great incentive. At first, the game is interesting, but after some time it practically becomes an obligation - not exactly a quality I'm looking for in a game. Oh, and also, it's false advertising to create ads that imply different gameplay

I've been playing this for a couple days before writing a review. The game is interesting. My issue is that the orders to complete get increasingly more advanced while the amount of ingredients you get are SO LOW that you spend all your coins to complete one or two orders only! Who wants to spend 100+ coins and you don't even have enough to complete an order of coffee level 5?! If orders are advanced, then give us more advanced items! Either you $buy$ energy or take days to fulfill 3 orders.

I would give this game 5 stars if it were based on game play alone. I love the game, but the fact that once you're a higher level it takes days to fill orders is insane. And the side quests are impossible. I have even paid for several things and still have trouble. the fact that you have to use 2 energy to play 1 level higher stuff is also stupid. as you merge better item generators you should be able to get better items easier.

It's a fun game with great graphics but it is impossible to play without spending money. I get about 5 mins of play and then have to wait hours for the energy to renew OR spend money to buy something to keep playing. After a point it just becomes pointless to play. It takes hundreds of merged items that use energy points and you don't get even a fraction back when you reach the goal. I'm ok spending a bit of money but this game is very very greedy.

requires too much money to enjoy. if you do not spend money, the game is sooooo slow and almost not enjoyable for more than 10 minutes at a time every 4 hours. it takes hours for your energy to turn back to full. but the more you play the MORE energy is required to complete tasks. so it becomes even less enjoyable. Things start to take 2 wéeks to complete if u don't play every 2 hours and spend money. probably a better game out there. back to clash of clans I go

I've played a lot of merge games and this is probably my favorite. The artstyle is cute, the items aren't too painstaking to make once you get a ways into the game, although it can progress slowly at the beginning. The events are fun, creative, and engaging (except the pirate event where you compete against 99 other people, that one isn't worth the prize at the end!) Aside from some issues with events not giving enough time to complete them, I don't have any complaints.

It's fun, but the way the order system works is ridiculous. You can spend 200+ energy trying to get one potato or lil iced tea. This game may market as no ads and free, but frankly, the only way to really advance is to spend money. Otherwise, you're waiting for hours on end for your energy to restore or hoping an energy chest gives you enough so you can get that one item that rarely shows up to complete what you wanted. This game should have a better way of gaining energy.

Game is OK, but it's boringly slow without paying. Litterally, you will play few minutes and wait for hours to get energy without buying it for a real money. Also, odds to get what you need from sources on the board are very low and everything is just made to be slow and slow so you get into paying, but the story and dynamics of the game is not worth to make it paying game. Good try, but unistall is inevitable.

AD is a lie. You don't have to make choices about repairing a window or fixing a door. It's a MERGE game. Merge stuff and sell, make money to make upgrades to your restaurants. Same as most Merge games these days. Not as interesting or addictive. Energy count is too low for the needs that have to be met. Definitely a DO NOT RECOMMEND type of game. No uniqueness.

Ads are misleading for gameplay. The gameplay itself is fun, but the ads aren't accurate. Finally downloaded the app after being bombarded by ads. It was specifically the $100 bonus that got to me to download it, but that bonus doesn't exist. There is a minimal level-up beginner bonus at the early levels but nowhere near the same thing as the app recognising you followed the link from the ad and getting a $100 value reward. Deceitful.

Don't waste your time on this game. Its fun until you get to around level 40, then you have to start spending lots of money. Its definitely a pay to play game. Energy takes a long time to regenerate. 100 energy is not enough to merge items at a higher level, hence to why you have to spend money. Also side challenges require spending money to complete.

the story is all right and the merge gameplay is all right. but if you want to finish any event you have to spend money and to not just money but a lot of money. I hadn't spent anything on the game, but I decided to try to complete one event and after spending $25 I still hadn't come close to finishing it. so if you're a completionist, avoid this game like the plague.

another game with LYING ads. after seeing all the ads I thought it looked interesting but nope. nothing in the ads is in the gameplay. there's an ad with a "ceo" upset people weren't downloading their game claiming it was free with no annoying ads or paid services. BS it's just another energy based game that you can't play when you run out unless you wait hours or spend money. i would have considered spending money in it if the game were ANYTHING resembling the 100s of different ads they put out

It was decent at first, but the storyline just drags on and is pointless and seems to never go anywhere. There's a bunch of dialog that is completely pointless that you have to spend too many coins on. I don't want to spend coins for a character to come in and then be like, "Actually, I'm gonna go." It is pointless and doesn't add anything to the story.

update: still sucks. im always literally just a couple coins or points away on winning a challenge and time runs out. don't waste your money! game used to be a daily fun. now they made it to where your literally in reach of winning whatever promo or contest they have, then they make you lose. and the game has started Glitching. once you get the level up gift boxes as a prize, once you get them, they don't go onto your gaming board. extremely disappointing and I WONT be spending another penny.

Terrible!! I couldn't even get past the *very* first step of *merging* 2 icons the way they were demonstrating on screen - it wouldn't work! I managed to make it happen on the first one after ages trying (not sure how) and then same problem a second later with the next one. So I was constantly played persistent and loooong ads on other games, and then the actual game won't let me play. Uninstalled.

This MIGHT be a great game BUT the creators dont increase your energy to correlate with the increased amounts needed as you reach higher levels. The orders become more complex, and it becomes impossible to do anything on 100 energy. So you can play an average of about 2 MINUTES and have to stop playing again and come back HOURS later. Not a good way to keep players using your game! And they dont even offer watching ads as a way to earn more energy! They refuse to address this problem! GREEDY!

Downloaded due to all the annoying ads which I still hate. as many have said game play is not like the ads, there's no problem solving. it is an enjoyable game but it does get to the point you don't really progress fast. it's also incredibly slow to load and quite often there are massive updates which take forever to download and you have to keep that screen open to download them unlike when updates are don't through Google play. however it is ad free like they say

It's quite addictive but you run out of energy fast. Lots of events and such to gain more energy or gems to buy more energy or special items. Without spending money you can play about 10-20 minutes about every 3 hours. It's just fun, slow pace and it never frustrates. It doesn't have levels to pass and definitely no pay to win. No need to watch a ton of adds either. You can choose to do so for some items and energy but you could play completely add free if you want and still progress in the game

I spent £40 on the game and all that happens is when you buy more "diamonds" everything you need them for costs more and more. It's a total rip off. In the first few rounds things cost very low amounts but fter a while you're paying ten times that for a lot less.

4 stars only due to the fake ads I keep seeing for the game while I'm using other apps. They present gameplay as having to match three items in order to save Quinn and Olivia (the mom and daughter) by rebuilding a ramshackle house. While the game does feature rebuilding it's not in the same context, and it's a merge game to fulfill orders not a match 3. With how engaging the actual gameplay and story is I don't see why these deceptive ads are necessary. Lose the lies and I'd make it a 5.

I love this game, play every day. the matching is soothing, it's one of the few I'll spend a teeny bit on sometimes-- there are also a good amount of ways to get more energy or items if you don't spend at all! choosing the decor is fun and I like the plot development bits. ads are basically only for more energy! but I have one problem. and I think most would. nobody wants to have to click ok on 6 separate popup windows for all the mini games you added this week. STOPPPP for the love of God!

Fun and Entertaining, but Could Use a Few Fixes I decided to give Gossip Harbor a try after seeing many of my friends play it, and I haven’t regretted it. It is a really fun and engaging game that keeps you entertained for hours. However, there are a bit too many ads, and the energy runs out quite fast. Despite that, I’d still definitely recommend it!

Found this game via an ad & haven't looked back! The "no ads" claim is mostly true; optional ads for upgrades exist, but it's not forced after every move like other games. Only spent money bc of play points, otherwise I never would. My gripes: energy drains too fast & takes too long to replenish. Plus, constantly remaking the prepared seafood dish is annoying & eats up precious energy. Why only seafood disappears is beyond me!

I used to love this game, the storyline, the side quests. But they make it so you can never win, I've spent quite a bit of money to make it to the end of a storybook or challenge. I dont mind paying for a game. But even after spending well over 12 euros in 1 day I cant seem to win. So far I've spent tens and tens of euros but never made it to the end of a challenge. Such a shame and makes me want to uninstall it.

Game itself is alright, surprisingly got me hooked in at first with the plot but after a while the story started getting worse and worse, I started disliking the main character who just keeps being suspicious of everything and everyone despite it all and keeps being stuck in a love triangle forever in an endless push and pull that makes me wanna scream at the screen...used to really enjoy but I gave up

not as advertised. so the game is ok. the story is all over the place, questionable actions from the main character. So it's not the "sadistic looking save the cold, sad child and woman by repairing the broken down house in a snow storm" the ads push and explicitly specify that this game is not like other games and it is that game that is advertised...its not.

I am not a "merge 3" game girl but I am enjoying the "kitchen" where merging lower rank items creates higher ranked items. It requires patience and planning as you determine what is necessary to build an order fir a customer. The storyline, to me, is secondary. I am just having fun and don't find it necessary to spend any money...I just have to be patient while the energy required to create ingredients recharges.

Dear Microfun, This is a good game that I really enjoy playing. However, it is pointless to have challenges that cannot be beaten past a certain level because the orders take up more energy and therefore more time. At least fix the challenge point system if nothing else.

Great merge game, but not enough energy. Sometimes play is only 5 minutes or less, items needed can take all your energy for 3 or 4 visits. I find myself going back every couple of hours to try and get 1 item. Also not long enough time is given to finish each event. I've not completed 1 yet.

The reviews I see give Gossip Harbor a lot of hate, which I don't understand. It's fundamentally a good game. A lot of care has obviously been put into the art and game play. And the story is cute. But it's not perfect. Foremost, the game you play isn't the one advertised. It's a "merge" puzzle game with limited resources where you earn coins to advance the story. There are no mandatory ads, but watching ads moves things faster as do in-game purchases. If you understand that, it's fun.

So many glitches!! every night I go to bed with a certain amount of progress, the next day that progress is set back on some parts of the game, but not others. this is a daily experience and I've taken screenshot to prove it. yes the game is free and ad free, but you end up spending so much money if you want any chance at progressing and finishing challenges in the window of time they give. the game is fun and addictive, but I'm uninstalling before I waste anymore money on it.

I've seen one user report that this game is nothing but microtransactions—and yes, there can be a lot of ads for them. But it's a free game, so if you don't know to expect those by now, I don't know what to tell you. I've been playing this game a LOT, and of the variety of merge-types I've tried, this one is absolutely the best. Cute story, cute art, and you genuinely CAN get very far without ever spending a dollar on the game. I suggest giving it a try! I love it, personally!

I enjoy the game. However, a few things need to be changed. One day the price of 800 diamonds and 300 energy will be 9.99, the next day, same offer but for 15.99. I think more people would spend more money with some consistency. I know I would. Another thing is the amount of energy it takes to get to some of the items does NOT reflect the coins given for that item. More coins for high energy items. The cost to just have a chat with someone should be way lower. Not 400 coins for a convo.

Very good game, relaxing to play, but nothing like what they are advertising at the moment, (June 2026). Personally haven't continued playing the game for some time now, however managed to get very far in the game. Interesting storyline, well worth the download (Just again, don't expect to get what they're advertising, it is much more than that)

the matching part of the game is good. the storyline is also good. like so many merge type games, actually getting to the game once I open the app is too much. multiple campaigns going on at the same time, having to go through all of the instructions prompts of some of them makes me want to close and not play, which sometimes I do that. just let me play the game and click on things that I want to know more about

Been playing this for a long time now. And yes, I've been buying weekly, sometimes too much but it has come to a time where the goals(weekly, quests, etc.) are so hard to accomplish. Even if you literally set an alarm for every 3 hrs, you still won't finish them as F2P (heck! Even I buy packs and still lose) You can't win or keep the streak unless you purchase packs and I mean lots of them. I'll be uninstalling the game soon, if not, I'll stop buying packs since it's pretty much useless now.

It would be 5 stars, but the moment I paid for some of the offers, I stopped winning as much. Cards are also hard to get now, whereas before, it wasn't easy, but not this hard. I still haven't won an ingame yet and have bought the $7.99 side offer, always making it to the last stage but never finishing, lol . I do really enjoy the game, though. I live for Mark and Sam. I do hope Quinn finds a good man and just keeps a good, friendly relationship with Colton, he's just too much.

addicting and fun game, you don't have to spend money on it. there's ways to play the game efficiently without paying so you can complete events. also if you don't spend money you can watch videos for free energy and stuff. I personally spend a little on the game since it's the only game I really play. if you do spend money things will go up in price every time but if you take a break and not buy anything for a few weeks everything will be cheaper again.

Unfair features and no good if you won't spend money. Game says ooh a new feature use x8 for better game play, but when you use x8 majority of the time you only get something worth 4 energy so where is the other 4? It's wasted!!! Game is very hard to play if you're not willing to pay money, especially when you level up because no matter the level you are capped at earning 100 energy. I keep hoping it'll get better but it's impossible win some of the challenges. Makes me not want to play anymore.

This is one of those games whose ads look *nothing* like the game. The ads make it look like you're going space by space, making choices on how to actually *repair* a house, picking where you work. That is, whether to fix a chimney or window, how to do it (window or tape), and so on. So I d/l'd it. And was ticked off. It's a weird match three game where you have to make the pieces that you then use to match. And the "repairs" you make are just a "choose from these three" for a cafe. Deleted!

DO NOT DOWNLOAD, nothing like the adds. it's true that there are no adds, but this game is pure pay to win. it is highly addictive, and after about 2 weeks of playing you will see that you can't do anything unless you start paying for add ons. it is impossible to complete the weekly missions without paying, which is frustrating. It was actually fun for the first week, but when you inevitably hit that wall, you will hate this game, unless you want to pay, in which case enjoy!

game is fun to play (when you get to play) energy regeneration tops out at only 100 and you need way more than that to finish an order, so you go for the gem/energy deals they run but that's not enough, this is mostly a pay to play game and so far I've spent like 140$ or 150$ on it. honestly I'm a bit irritated with it at this point and would give it negative stars if I could.

I loved this game at the beginning and middle levels. it was almost addictive. Then play slows WAY down as it takes more and more play and refill wait time to complete orders and move the story forward. It's the same issue as Whisper Castle. It's like you're punishing your most loyal players. So I'm sorry to say I'm uninstalling both today.

don't waste your time or money on this game, its IMPOSSIBLE to complete any event being free to play, even when I wanted to buy energy, the prices are INSANE 15.99 for a "sale" is insane!! Edit: they responded saying the game is designed for everyone to have fun except you can only play for 5 min before you run out of energy, and the prices are INSANE to refill, I'm doubling down on my 1 star after their response!!!

I'm uninstalling Gossip Harbour not because it's a bad game, but because it's too expensive to enjoy. I'm on Level 120, and I've realized the game constantly pushes you to spend. You get only 100 free energy, yet many orders require over 400. After checking my payment history, I was shocked by how much I'd spent in just one week. It's a fun game, but it's not for me anymore. I'm going back to Township, where I can actually have fun without feeling pressured to keep paying.

i played lots of merge games, this is easily the best one in the market! mystery and romance based storyline, amazing and likable characters and dialogues to die for. i laud the devs for choosing an overused gameplay type and being able to invest all of their time and money to story and events. genuinely cant praise it enough. but one problem is that sometimes the game overtimes during ads and reopens, and you cant get the item you already watched the ad for. pls fix it.

😩 another play to play. the only true things about this as that was true is that there are no annoying ads. however, the game is nothing and I mean nothing in this game that resembles the ads story lines. I've spent money on this game and all it's done is make the request harder, like 40% of the requests are taking between 200-500+ for those orders. you don't feel like you can accomplish any of the side events

don't believe the ads saying you'll be playing survival games to help the mom. the graphics don't even match. It is ad free, at least. The story is cute but it starts to get monotonous, trying to figure things out, then there's something else. you can play without spending money, just don't expect to make much progress.

for a game that claims to have no ads when they push things out for attention, there is so many ads. and if they are not ads, whatever is going on has a black screen pop up with a X at the right corner, can't do anything until the X is clicked, and then it just restarts the whole app. i can barely play the game because it happens ever thirty seconds to one minute in the game. don't recommend if you wish to play a decent game, not decent at all.

it duplicate cjarged me twice. after spending way to much in this have over the year, when I asked for a refund for a duplicate charge of $2.11 & $3.17, they refused to help me. Overall okay game, the graphics are good and energy is easy to come along without having to pay for it constantly. Recharge on the generators are fairly quick too. However, the overall plot to the game and all the 'gossip drama' SUCKS. It is more infuriating than it is actually entertaining, especially the further you progress in the game. I understand now why I've been told in the past you won't want to keep the game super long. If you completely skip the dialogue, you'll probably enjoy this.

There should be an option to keep off the story-telling. It is clunky & uninteresting, and I dislike even the unnecessary mild swearing. Game play seems to need a bit better balance in how often energy renews or bonuses come vs the requirements to make more items. Also, having some of the generating items run out. There should be a gauge to show how much longer it will work. Game was okay, but not worth keeping. Also, disappointing that the teasers for the game aren't part of it.

I actually love playing this game, but that's why I have a complaint. Once you get to a certain point, all orders start to be high-level items. This means 100 energy runs out quick, and there's no real way to earn energy outside of making in-game purchases or waiting. I'd love to play this game for extended periods, but if you're not in a good spot to win the prize items, you just get forced to quit quickly. I'd happily choose to watch ads to earn energy, but it only allows this sparingly.

The primary gameplay of merging items to complete restaurant orders is kinda fun, however, with each level you advance, the items for each order become more and more difficult to obtain. If you're not spending money, some orders take 2 or 3 days to complete. That's ridiculous. The racing events are terrible, they require so many resources, almost no one wins, and it costs 100s and 100s of energy units. Designed for pay to play and huge time suck (hours per day). If that's not you, don't download

Like other commenters, I really like the style, games, art and story line design... but you only get one or two days of good game playing before it becomes impossible to progress (like most merge games). I just spent 5-minutes of clicking and merging to barely get half a sandwich (uses 100 energy pts/purchase)--and then have to wait hours to play again. Not good value of you choose to purchase. I'm super disappointed because the game has so much potential; instead it's just frustrating. Delete.

Game keeps you intrigued. However, unable to make much progress without paying frequently to progress further into game. Items are overpriced and it seems the creator focuses more on ways to get users to pay, than to solely enjoy the game. Had it for 3 days. Will most likely uninstall. Not spending $30-$150 daily to keep playing game. Nice concept and construction, too many in app purchases to enjoy it. The further along into game, the more it cost. It's a bit expensive for this type of game.

At first, this game was great. For about the first 10 stages, you would get a really good reward for leveling up, including chests and refill on energy. However, once you pass this level, you get no more leveling up refills on energy. The orders get ridiculously complicated, and you spend ask 100 energy is 10 minutes. Plus, the game has it rigged where it's hard to get enough potatoes and tea to finish orders. Plus, you spend almost 200 coins on a conversation with no rewards. Don't spend money.

I really dont want to uninstall this game. I really like it and it's very addictive. But it makes no sense that It takes days just to finish an order... energy runs fast and takes too long to replenish! why do I need 400 energy for 1 dish? that's absurd! Also, with the fish. I have to use energy to create the fish tray or whatever you call it, then have to use more energy to create a fish recipe! You don't care, you just want money!

Extremely fun and SURPRISINGLY diverse??? But it's criminal how easy it is to spend money on this game. 😭 I wish there were more easy / free ways to get more energy instead of the 3 hours and 20 minutes it takes to recharge back to 100 energy. :/ I know the game needs to make money, but JEEZ it can be expensive... I just want to merge!! 😭🔥 (Oh, and the story is ok too).

I agree with the other 1-star ratings. The game is fun, cute, and has an interesting story line. But, the game play truly is 'Mini'. You get 'energy' to spend on each match you make and you can only accumulate 100 energy when you're offline. This goes against every game I've ever played. The matches get more and more difficult where the fun completely disappears and it's frustrating to play 3-min for 100 energy and then wait hours for energy to rebuild. Not a good game for longevity playing.

This game is money driven, even if you spend money they make it extremely difficult to finish events pushing you to spend more money. play only if you have loads of money to spend or don't mind not finishing events.

even though there are no ads. game has many issues. story plays out so slow despite you using many coins. Energy given isn't enough to meet game deadlines. You end up needing to purchase packages. and that alone has issues. sometimes it doesn't work, and you have to contact support to redeam your rewards. or you pay for a pack, and they decide to make a new theme and end the pack you purchased. overall, the game would be a lot better if you didn't constantly need to purchase. money grabbing game

I like the game, but I am having so many problems with it that I am considering deleting it. Most of the time, it won't load and when it does, I can make 2or3 moves and then the game hangs up and boots me out! Then I have to wait at least an hour and a half before I can get it to load long enough to play. Sometimes it won't let me play for days at a time and I have NO chance to do the special challenges. You have too much trouble trying to get any jems.

Unless you're willing to spend money, don't bother. Started out great but quickly grew boring. Higher level items can take literally days to get due to the 100 energy cap. Five minutes of game play every few hours? No thanks! Even if you spend money, you can't win the side games. The bundles to purchase are way over priced and still barely contain enough energy. I love this type of game so I've downloaded 10 of them and rotate play. This one is the worst for energy and prices.

I've been playing this game for a couple months now and when you have the energy to play it is really enjoyable, but when you become a person who plays daily, the algorithm pretty much scolds you. When you get energy it's minimal (like 25 at most), the orders take days to fulfill, and if you spend money in the game, the energy chest box is no longer free to get by watching ads. If you check out different forums online, you can see the discrepancy on how much things cost for several people.

I enjoy this game and I spend quite a lot of money on it. However, it will just have you continue spending money to be able to fulfill any orders the higher up in levels you go. What other people say about being able to watch ads for energy is correct, that option goes away completely after you start purchasing things. You think they would reward you for purchasing things. Nope.

For 1, it's a match game, so if you think it's like the ads, it's not. The number of things you need to make 1 item is beyond ridiculous. I'm only on level 2. You have a bag that gives food, you need potatoes but all it gives is 10-15 bread to 1 potato, but you need 12 potatoes for 1 dish so it's a very long and that's just 1 item. By the time you try to make the 1 dish, you are already out of energy. I ran out of energy twice in 5 minutes. They refill it once for free.

I love this game! except for the fact you CONSTANTLY are forced to STOP playing it unless you decide to spend money. If there were ads available in order to continue playing all the time, I would. but they don't even give you that option! you run out of "energy" and you have to wait for more. the energy recharges 1 every 2 minutes. that's insane. I am always forced to exit the app and wait like 3 hours just to be able to play with 100 energy (it maxes out at 100 when recharging)for only 5 mins!

The game is nice with pleasant-to-eyes graphic. The story is questionable and somewhat ridiculous, but you can ignore it. The biggest issue of this game is the long cool down and you can run out of spaces easily. The orders are a problem, too. After a few hours playing, the game would give you many difficult orders that you need days to complete. Thus, it's hard to complete the events and you need to spend much money to speed things up. Ignore the story and the events, and you'll enjoy the game.

I spent a bit of time playing this game, got to level 38. It was fun at the beginning, but the progression is horribly designed. You would think that as the orders require more merges, the energy regeneration would expand and increase. Nope. Instead you get to spend 2x the energy at 2x the cost. I held on by guiltily purchasing a discount energy pack here and there. But then they introduced 3x the energy at 3x the cost once I hit level 30s. For the long run, I don't recommend.

I played this game for about a week to give it a chance. The game comprises mostly of doing little tedious and redundant merges. Some of the finishing projects take way too long. Like I said, I played for a week, and they never finished creating the salvation dog for the prize. The merging process isn't even that fun. It feels like a chore. All this, while you hardly get any energy to play with, so you either have to spend your own money, or keep checking back in through out the day to play.

Simple and easy for the most part. I enjoyed the little story, although my restaurant was coming out ugly because I just don't like the style choices, no biggie. This game has been uninstalled for one reason. The amount of energy that it takes to continue playing is absolutely ridiculous. I was able to blow through over a hundred energy to finish one order. It takes two minutes to earn one energy. This is a cash grab game, and I no longer want any part of it. Sorry.

The game is misleading. You run out of turns fast so that you're tempted to make purchases... The time to wait for certain things to load is long, overall not fun after a while. Frustrating pop ups for once again more in app purchases. The storyline would be a lot more interesting if it was actually more than having to read it. I'm deleting the app after this. 5/10, do not recommend...

More false ads! The gameplay is repetitive and Nothing like what's shown in the ads, which specifically tell you they're showing you games from within the app. They have an add promising $100.00 worth of in-game packs for free if you use that ad to download now, but that didn't work either. I asked customer service about that ad, and I was told, "You can get rich rewards by playing continuously," and "various game element illustrations and upgrade rewards will be unlocked." What a load of BS!!

Game play is way too slow for any enjoyable progress. Specialty/energy items take too long to open or recharge and sometimes disappear after being used 10 times. It shouldn't take an entire day of trying every few hours to complete one order. Very money driven game. Ridiculous. Also, if an item takes 40 energy to create, it shouldn't be 3 energy to sell if you need space.

the game is good to play, engaging... addicting even... but once you start getting past level 12, energy hardly lasts at all, the story line is inane and not satisfyingly advancing, and to play longer than a few minutes at a time you have to keep throwing money at the game. sure, there are no "ads" but there are constant pop ups trying to get you to spend "just a few dollars" every single day. this game has big potential to be a giant drain on your time and wallet if you're not careful.

This game is only fun to play if you're willing to spend your whole paycheck to play it for any length of time. It takes tons of energy to fill orders and the energy is super slow to regenerate so you only get about 5 minutes of play time every 4 hours if you don't pay for more. And even then you have to merge so many items in the higher levels you get very little for the amount of money you have to spend. I'm going back to Royal Kingdom. ✌️

I like it quite a bit, but to keep playing you have to spend money. There should be more options to watch videos to earn energy to play. The actual playtime you get is quite short. Nobody should have to spend that much money to play a game. Update 10/22/2025. I chose to uninstall this game. When you first install it there is quite a bit of rewards and ads to watch to earn free energy. Once you get past this phase you will not see an ad to watch again. It's definitely a pay to play game.

Interesting story, nice graphics, a little bit addictive.. Yes, they offer some tempting packages to solve tasks quicker for money, of course. 😏 I had fun, paid a few and enjoyed my time while playing. It's possible to resolve tasks without paying but if you it takes time to recharge if you're playing for free. I would recommend; if the task during the story line is pricier (in coins) if not exp. poins, give at least something extra, because it's absurd to spend 150 coins and get 15 exp.

The game itself is fun and addictive but I have some issues. No matter how far you get in the game, the number of energy you can get never increases. Why would I still be getting a max of 100 energy in level 40? That doesn't make any sense, and it's also unfair. The harder the games gets, the more energy we should get as well. secondly, when I saw the ad and downloaded the game, I was promised 100usd worth of free gifts that I never got- and before you ask-Yes, I downloaded it using the link.

After spending as much as a Sims 4 DLC in 2 weeks, I gave up on this game. All the offers are in your face, but the game is limited enough to enjoy, but not enjoyable for the story and gameplay to be enough. I've uninstalled the game as all the offers and gameplay seem designed around delayed satisfaction - enough to want more, but you have to pay to continue. Honestly, if it's not challenging enough to keep me entertained for a long period of time, it's not worth my money; and it's not cheap.

What I expected: fun at first, then a tedious grind fest. I don't care anything about the story, so I just skipped that. Everything is fine for a while because matching is easy to fill orders. But it doesn't take long before you are finding yourself burning through energy for very little advancement, repeatedly combining low level materials in a long grind. There's no way I'm spending money on a game like this, but that appears to be the only way to make actual progress, so I'm uninstalling.

I've been playing for about 8 months and used to enjoy the game but devs keep revising and eliminating ways to achieve orders. which is the whole point in playing. it takes SO MUCH energy (and days) to complete a single order, that you miss out on the rewards or the simple satisfaction. It's just a money grab game now. Game play is about 2 mins, which makes it feel like a chore. So I'm deleting. I have a different merge game that is actually enjoyable.

Annoyed! Can never play the game to enjoy it because you run out of energy quickly. All the items you purchase are high cost items. The special it you create to collect diamonds takes longer than a month to put together because there's never enough energy to suffice 1 order most times. I like the game but I can't enjoy it. I'm going to p playing soon.

At first we liked it so much that we spent money, but the more you play the same, the more ridiculous the requests are, with little energy and little rewards, you wont be able to keep up. Also, at first, they give free energy when you watch ads, now nothing. Cards event is close to impossible with the repeating cards. Fun now, but not a long term game. Too bad, we spent real money on superpass, to support the dev, but once you spent money, they think you are a cash cow and grabs everything.

Prize items disappear! I've been playing this game for almost a year now and noticed that some of the items won in the bonus games, i.e. treasure boxes and advanced food items would disappear. At first, I thought I may have used them and don't remember, but I confirmed my suspicion when I won a seafood item, split it, used half, and then saved the other. I checked for it today, knowing I would need it, and now it's gone. This has happened several times and now is a nuisance. Not worth it

False advertising, dont fall for it. I've had this game installed for well over a year and it's not like this. There are no episodes or puzzles. It's purely merging, with choices of 3 different color/styles for fixing and redecorating when you get enough coins. The game itself is easy because that's all you do. Zero thinking required. It's incredibly addicting though, which is how they get people to pay real money.

Fun to play at first, moves fast, advancement and level ups come easy, but by level 20, grinding halt. Your free 100 energy will not fill even one order, forcing you to buy more, or wait another 100 minutes to fill 1/2 an order. Bottom line, fun game if you've got deep pockets and don't mind the ever increasing cost to play, but if you enjoy playing for free, skip this one.

My honest opinion? It's a fun little game. Now, my complaint is not about the energy recharge, or anything, it's more about the generator pieces that take AGES to obtain. other games of the same type and developer (like Seaside Escape, for example) reward you with pieces so much faster. Wish there was a way to obtain at a higher rate. Tired of seeing useless pieces on my board that I can't even store because I'd rather use my gems for other things and not opening up more storage.

Energy takes too long to fill up and not enough ways to get some quickly, so I usually take about 2-3min to use up all meger 100 energy, then literally have to log off for hours, so I don't get to really enjoy and play the game. Also takes too long, many, many energy, etc, to reach an item that might be like 5+ items on the list. Just needs to rework a lot of things. Creators should really try and spend as much time as we do and get to feel the frustrations we feel playing their games *shrug*

I have very mixed opinions of this game. On one hand, the actual gameplay loop is fun (with a caveat). I also appreciate that the characters are diverse, with people of multiple races and ages and orientations. It is, however, a case of really bad false advertising. (Please just advertise the actual game?) It's also clearly designed to get you to spend money, and could be dangerous for those with low impulse control. Even just making energy recharge faster would help it feel less skeevy.

Game geared exclusively for pay for play. Take a game, calculate parameters needed for an hour of a comfortable play and then cut that by an order of ten and then charge for the play. This is what this game is: do NOT expect to get more than about 5-10 minutes of play continuously about 3 times a day. If you don't pay(and the amounts are substantial) you do not play. They got me, their graphics are decent and the story mildly engaging. I found more honest merge games I will support instead.

A bit boring because it is slow and not interactive enough because of the wait times. Also, there is not much fun while in the game to earn more energy to keep playing. Paying is the only option to keep playing. Not worth it... The energy levels MUST be increased to keep the player more engaged. 100 is definitely not enough - especially as the level keeps increasing

I like this game, I really do. It's fun and well-paced.. when you can actually play it. The energy mechanic completely kills the fun of this game and ruins everything about it. when I play a game, I want to be able to sit and immerse in playing that game for a while, but with the energy in this? You can't. You can play for MAYBE 1 minute and then you have to wait hours for the energy to refill or buy gems to refill it and the gem price to refill goes up. At level 7 it just gets worse onward.

I feel so dumb actually writing a review over this game. 😂😂 Especially this one. Because the actual game mechanics are great. No pushy ads. Art style is great. I can hop on for few minutes a couple of times a day and progress enough that it feels worth it. But I'm uninstalling it over the plot. 😂😅🤦‍♀️ I've leveled up into the 20s and the way the main character interacts with her ex-husband annoys me to no end. I googled and it keeps going into the 60s at least so on that note... I'm out!

I truly love this game. However, once you spend money a few times..(which in order to level up you have to.) They increase the amounts. For the same thing they offered pretty cheap in the beginning. The energy is expensive once you add it up. I am about to delete the game because of the greed. How are you going to have a Christmas theme right now and increase your prices 15.00 for barely anything. No thank you. Not anymore. I have kids and this game isn't worth that much money & that sucks!

A Fun Game as a time waster, However, it is a slow progression game that takes away the enjoyment and time spent on the app. (1) You dont earn nearly enough coins from each completed order, as compared to other merge games. (2) After level 30, the maximum energy points need to increase from 100 to 200 as you progress. (3) Prizes, coin system, and mini games aren't enough to make you want to continue playing the game. The ultimate goal is for you to spend actual money. Which is a 👎🏾.

This game is very addictive. The bad part is waiting for things to recharge. I don't care for waiting. I wish there were more free opportunities to get energy and a little more free storage. It takes time to build energy, so some quest are not possible to finish without spending. I can't afford to purchase, so I end up losing some, but there are still a lot with the ability to win. I really like the game and hope the recharge times can be re-evaluated by you makers. Thanks for the game.

I've been playing for a few months now. I like the game itself. They used to give a free chest of a small amount of energy daily. That's gone now. As well as one of the two ads to allow 15 energy. It's definitely more pay to play than it used to be. That makes it really impossible to complete weekly tasks and events. I could play all day using energy as it comes in and still only complete one order. Once you become a higher level player, you get no ads, spend cash. Dropped a star.

Great at first. I really like this game but after the first few levels, the "cool down" time for energy takes forever and the amount of gems/coins you get decreases. The ads say you can play the game without spending money which is technically true for any game, but if you want to play more than a couple minutes at a time, you would have to spend money. It's just frustrating because I really like the game overall but I'm constantly waiting for my energy to replenish.

Review is largely in regards to the insane number of ads I've started seeing for this game that are just generic [insert name of game here] ads, or ads claiming that this game is "the game where you save the mother and child from freezing to deth". It's lazy and it's false in the latter case, not to mention annoying. This game is fine. It's exactly like every single other game where you merge things to restore a place and progress the story.

I have seen from the reddit that if you spend more money,they charge more. What one person is charged for a pack is less or more depending on how much they have spent. This means that they basically punish customers. I'm a person who doesn't mind paying a little toward a game that was well developed, but how dishonest to say it's a discount, but use your data to scam you into paying more. They are v greedy, and they do things deliberately with challenges to make it where you have to spend more.

Frustrating! I have played game for a year, spent more money than I care to admit. I've never been able to finish any card catalogs. the closest I got was 9 cards left. weekly restaurant goals are also impossible to complete. once you get close to completing, the card packs have no new cards, items needed to complete mini games also "disappear". I like the game overall, but not being able to complete goals, tasks, catalog, etc it's not worth the frustration!

Games are supposed to be for you—for relaxation and fun. This game is against you, fighting for your money. The longer I stay in the game, the greedier it gets. It gets worse and worse with each new level. The rewards for competitions and mini-games are super difficult to get without spending real money, and the rewards themselves become so meager that it's not worth the effort. I made 1 to 3 purchases every week, and still couldn't finish the monthly pass, and many games even with that!

The game is fun, but there's no way to earn energy by watching ads, so at some point, you start buying the packages (special offers) and the more regularly you use special offers, the more expensive they get. It started with 3$-10$ offers, and now all my offers start from 10$ and go to 50$. It is a very addictive game, in a bad way. It's easy to spend a lot of money, so be careful and play reasonable.

Deceptive practices - money grab. I keep playing because it passes the time, and I like merging the pieces but don't spend money on this game. I've tried multiple ways to complete the events, even with spending money. The algorithm makes it increasingly difficult to "complete" the event. Notice each order you complete, and the rewards decrease by a lot. Deceptive practices. I give it 1 star. I've requested a refund all money spent. I want it all back!

The storyline is terrible. Typos, poor grammar, slow moving, and rather stupid. The decorating part is boring and a waste of time. I do enjoy the matching part of the game ("filling orders"), but I can play for 30 seconds before I lose energy. I get the game is designed to get people to pay a lot of money so they can keep playing, but come on...you expect me to invest in a game I can only play for 30 seconds? And after spending money, I can only play for 3 to 5 minutes? Ridiculous.

I was torn on this game, but now I'm done. I was really frustrated at how fast energy was depleted in the game and how low production some items were. Then came the super special gifts, which not only took a board space for the engine but then took up to 8 board spaces for all the gift pieces (dogs, Lego, pearls). Now, at later levels, I'm energy bare before I complete one order. it's like they don't want you to play the game that's the same as 20 others on the market.

I've been playing this game for a while, made multiple purchases as well, I enjoyed the mechanics/ design of the game, but unfortunately the game became too greedy and can't be enjoyed without spending lots of money continuously. 100 energy every 3 hours is so slow when many orders need at least 300-1000 energy to be done. It needs to be balanced. Such a shame I'm uninstalling it even though I was a big fan.

This is the best merge game, in my opinion. However, my biggest issue with this game which led me to uninstall is that the generator upgrades have literally 0 impact on your progression, but obviously the orders get harder and harder to fulfill and at a certain point you feel the game experience is not rewarding anymore and there is no long term goal or anything to look forward to. Another flaw is the spawn rate of tea and potato. It will be much more enjoyable if a pity system is added.

It's kinda sad, really. The game itself is not bad, your typical "merge items to upgrade them" game, but the story is good and the redecorating tasks are cute and fun. The only problem is, it's definitely false advertising. That "this game is definitely about this, no lying ads" is, in fact, a lying ad. I like the game and that's the only reason I gave 2 stars and not 1, but misleading ads are a hard no for me

$$$$ in order to level up. example, to refill energy its 160 gems, of which it would take you 6 months to earn. would be an awesome game if it wasn't trying to constantly encourage purchases. incentives in game are low, but in order to complete the average order one item can take 600 energy. which would equal 10hrs to boost normally, most orders have 3 items. and the rewards are low items, rarely the extensively made.

I liked this game at first, but once you spend money the prices shoot up and free ad options disappear. Something that was 99¢ can jump to $10, and the game keeps raising prices based on what you’re willing to pay. They eventually drop again, but buying anything resets the hike. It feels exploitative. On top of that, the developers reply to reviews with the same copy-and-paste responses, which makes feedback feel ignored.

This game used to be fun, until developers ruined it. It was fun to strategize how to maximize your resources to complete really high level orders with the ice cube. They've now changed that and it takes several days to complete one order. All of this is out of greed, but I'm not going to give them money so I'm deleting the game. I don't recommend this game or anything by Microfun. Editing to add: I started by reaching out to support in-game. They lied and said nothing had changed.

So this game advertised too much about No-ads while making the other games as annoying as hell with lengthy ads about Gossip Harbor. Hence, I downloaded this game to find out it is nothing like the advertisement. I'm disappointed with false advertisements, since the actual game is nothing like the ads. Yes, it's a merging game which is not more than a 5-minute play, which leads to a 2 -3 improvement in a restaurant for the lady. I would say I feel really disappointed with the hype of false ads.

This used to be one of my favorite games, but the taking away of the free daily energy chest has really put a damper on it. I used to save up red bottles for some events; now it's taking a couple of days to accumulate any. I really like the side events with the separate merging board, and the adventure trail style ones. Absolutely hate the ones where more items get thrown onto the board to take up space needed to achieve higher level items.

Lovely game,but when you download a game,you want to spend some time to relax and not get anxious about rewards because you are always out of energy. In order to play daily for a decent amount of time you have to spend a lot of money! I am sure there are other merge games where with a 20 euro subscription you can enjoy a lot more benefits and not just for two minutes. As you level up,the orders become more and more demanding, and to just complete an order it might take 2 or 3 days time!

Graphics are great, story is good. The reason for the 3 stars is, you can only play for a short time unless you want to pay to cash to make progress. You're limited moves & then have to wait to for it to fill up again. For example been trying to get a Dalmatian for one of the characters. The doghouse only allows bout 6 turns then it recharges for 2.3 hrs before you can try again. Was gonna download another one of their games but why bother if it's gonna be the same problem.

This game starts off fun but it gets pretty dull as you further along the way. unless you purchase the power ups, it will take 2-3 days to complete a single order. At that rate, even if you purchase the power up packs, you will need to spend a lot of money just to finish one order. it's not worth the trouble. When you manage to create high value items they relegate them to orders that have no rewards. Went to social media to play along for power ups and they were never received.

I will say the game look and feel is great. The storyline will draw you in, it's intriguing and fun! However, it's absolutely nothing like the advertisements (of course 😮‍💨) and if you want to gain any progress... good luck. You basically have to dump a lot of money into it to get anywhere, so it's almost not worth my time. I end up leaving the game after 5-10 minutes because I have nothing left to do that isn't behind a paywall. I would've preferred the game in the ad though.

this is the second game I've played from these devs the ads lie. plain and simple. "the game is exactly what you see in the ad" no it isn't it's a copy paste of every merge game ever. "no pay to play" sure if you want it to take 3 full days to complete a single order. "no ads!" sure for external games. but it will constantly ask you to make in game purchases. and honestly you can hardly make any progress without buying stuff.

I really liked playing the game, but its a money sucker! over 3k in less than a month. (my own fault) but if you dont spend money you can only play for about 1 minute a day. also as you go up in levels, it costs more coins to buy things, and you get less coins when you fill an offer. Don't get sucked in. It also is nothing like the ads, totally different storyline. I will say that the app is fast and glitch free, pretty amazing how many different side games they have going and it works flawless

Fake. Advert isn't real. Continually refuses to generate needed food to merge once you're close to fulfilling a customer's order. Intentionally setup to slow the gameplay progress down if you don't spend your money to buy gems. And even if you do spend your money to buy gems, items are ridiculously expensive. And will continue to rise in price the more you spend. It is just a game version of a pyramid scheme. If I can give a rating less than a star, I would have.

I enjoyed the game at first since I received many awards and achievements. It's not that hard but sometimes, recharging is kinda annoying especially when you have no more diamonds left to buy. Also, the energy. It took too long to fully recharge. Hoping there's gotta be mini games to gain energies so we don't have to wait for how many minutes or hours before we could play. All in all, the game is satisfying. Having to wait for too long is my concern.

Overall I like this game. I've uninstalled more than once now, though, because eventually you reach a pay-to-play wall in the game where things stop being fun if you're playing for free. It's hard to progress after a couple chapters without spending money on diamonds; you run out of energy long before you complete your orders later in the game

The ad is a LIE. Nothing like described, yet it's just like all the other games like this. It's not exactly fun, but weirdly addictive. You run out of energy too fast, takes too much energy to fulfill orders. Recharging for the dogs keeps getting longer also taking forever to get to that goal. Too hard to achieve the time based games or anything unless you pay. Contemplating deleting as the frustration is outwaying the enjoyment. Same complaints by others, but nothing is done to make it better.

Edit: I've deleted. Storage is too expensive and impossible to play without. Sorry to complain, but it's too hard. I keep playing because the graphics are good and I like the story. But it's way too hard to advance. 50 gems to reopen a hub after only getting 6 items from it?! Over 200 gems to get ONE space in the inventory?! Nothing in a game should ever be 200+ gems. Free perks are minimal & once you buy gems you get less free energy. I can play about 10-15 minutes before I have no more moves.

I really enjoyed this game for a while and you can in theory play this without paying money, but like so many other games you hit a wall and in order to get anywhere at any reasonable speed you need to spend money. I finally lost it when I had an item that would only give you 4 units every few hours and you need 8 to create a different item. This new item would give you 6 items before it would be destroyed and you need 512 of this last item to satisfy one customer. No Thank you. UNINSTALLED.

Can't recommend; All of these style games are money-pits, but this one is especially egregious. Story is and dialogue are mediocre (at best), and the connections to 'choices' of design are often awkward enough to make that aspect an active hindrance. Moreso, the 'challenges' are often unable to be accomplished even when returning as frequently as possible.

Money hole! If you want to play this game for more than 5 or 10 minutes a day, you're going to have to spend money. There are no ads to watch in lieu of spending money and it takes about 3 hours for energy to come back to full, which is way WAY too long. Some orders can take 600 to 1000 energy to complete just THAT ONE order. Ended up deleting the app.

Fun gameplay & story's alright, but as you progress the orders become almost impossible to fill w/100 energy. Energy takes about 3 to 4 hours to refill fully since you only get 1 energy every 2 minutes, but some orders require up to 500 or more to complete. Some events end in 24 hrs. The higher level you are, the less you're able to participate in events unless you're willing to shell out tons of money. The game ads says it's free to play & that's true, but honestly the gameplay is a $ $queeze.

It's a fun game for about a day or so until you have to make higher level items, and then you're stuck making them for days unless you pay for more energy. Same goes for the events. They're impossible to even get halfway completed unless you pay for more energy....since starting the game there has been about 4-5 (maybe more) events and I couldn't even finish one because it took forever to gather what was needed. You waste so much energy and you barely are able to complete anything.

is that just me or does the fish plate give way less fish since the last update ? the game is fine but the story becomes boring at some point. It's a bit hard to get energy compared to other games of the story and it's a bit disheartening sometimes, but the little challenges are fun. you cannot complete them fully without paying, I get the point, because the game is fully ad-free

Nothing as advertised!! POINT SUCKER! YOU can't play much because you burn all your points or credits trying to achieve goals ex. one cup of coffee uses up to 30-40 points, if not more. everything cost plenty of games at a cost to pay.

Although I enjoy this game, I am giving it a 1 star for multiple reasons. 1. most of the time, it's high-level orders at the same time that require over 400 energy, with very minimal rewards and energy capped at 100. this hinders your ability to complete tasks and win events. 2. When I decided to make a small purchase to support the developers, the free energy chest started to cost 10 diamonds, and the same packages upped in price, and the orders became so much harder to force you to buy energy

Not as advertised. After seeing the ad for this a hundred times, ads that insisted this game was actually a save the family game, I downloaded it. after a few days I'm at level 10 and I still haven't had a scene to save the family. You match objects to create higher level objects to score coins that let you see dialogue of a story and decorate buildings. The higher the level, the harder it is to advance. Save yourself the grief and move on.

Don't write many reviews, but I've been playing this now for over a month and thought I'd share my thoughts since I play the game quite a lot. So first of all, fun, challenging and frustrating as well. I spend money on this game, VIP pass, buy gems etc. But some of these timed challenges I just cannot get done. I'm starting to feel like some are impossible without dropping HUGE amounts of cash and the not being able to finish is starting to make me get to the point where I want to delete.

It's a fun enough game, and there are no ads unless you want to watch in exchange for things, which is nice. However, the gameplay is not how it appears in the ads—it's a pretty standard merge game. The refill on energy is also painfully slow, so you can feel pressured to spend money if you want a play session of a decent length.

The most grating and dishonest ads I have ever seen for a game. They have, however, cut one ad really badly to say "Have you seen the ads about saving a mother and daughter but it's not real? Well this IS that game". It's merging items to make food for restaurant orders and choosing from 3 options to style your restaurant, all while reading a banal story. Oh, and the items you need to merge become rarer to get by level 2 and the energy system is really bad. But, it's as free!

Game is good, but as others have said, the energy filling up slowly is annoying. The game starts off progressing quickly, but it becomes slow to continue with the story later. I'm only at level 9, and it's already been bothering me. I should be able to unlock a higher energy capacity or lower wait time with a higher level. I read the other reviews and noticed it only gets worse with a higher level. If you don't like waiting hours for little progress don't waste your time on this game.

This game is fun, BUT I just realized that when you tap the item you need, it's taking 2 energies per tap. It's already hard enough to get what you need to merge, but to use 2 energies per tap is ridiculous. I play 3 other Microfun games plus their little games inside them, & if they are set up that way too, I will have to find other games to play. I know it's set up, so you will buy energy & I have. HOWEVER, I'm only getting to use half the energy that I paid for, and I feel ripped off.

Got an ad saying that if I download this game through the link then I'll be able to get free stuff worth over 100dollars. Didnt get anything. The ad mentioned that you could play this game for hours, but you're stuck with energy which needs time to recharge. Then thats false advertising. Can't even play more when I want to. Only thing true about the advertised thing was no ads. Yes, it doesn't have ads while playing. Only that deserves an additional star for my rating.

Clearly the creators don't care that the same comments are given in these reviews over and over again. You can only play this game for 3-5 minutes before waiting hours for energy to refill. And, after a few levels, you can't watch ads to refill energy because ads are "randomly assigned" to players. I would play this game for hours if it were possible to do so. But, you can't without spending ever-increasing amounts of money. So disappointing.

It's cute, but turns into a grind. While the tasks get more complicated and require more merges, unfortunately you're stuck with the same amount of energy (100) which recharges at the same rate as you had in the first level. This makes the tasks seem more like monotonous drudgery than anything else. It also is impossible to complete most of the special events without spending money. Story is cute at first, but grows old quickly. Main character is wishy-washy and annoying.

the orders take too long to fill, the rewards for the orders are too small for the time it takes to fill them, the ability to level up the supplies are too few and far between, there are too many different "competitions" going on and the renovation takes too many coins to do basically the smallest things like remove a box. I am now on level 77 and it does NOT get better. It takes literally days to complete one order without spending money.

I enjoy playing Gossip Harbor. The story and graphics are great, but the energy system completely ruins the experience. You only get 1 energy every 2 minutes, which makes it nearly impossible to play for more than a few minutes at a time. I constantly have to wait hours just to complete simple challenges or progress in the story. It makes it hard to stay engaged and enjoy the game for longer sessions. I’d give it a higher rating if the energy refilled faster or there were more ways to earn it.

Let's create an ad that displays an awesome game. A game so fun, everyone will want to play it. But when they do, let's make sure the game is nothing like the ad. I really don't understand why game developers do this. I know they get away with it legally by putting a mini game somewhere in the main game that does display that kind of gameplay. I literally had this game in my phone for less than 10 minutes and it is nothing like the game I thought I was installing. Uninstalling it now. Congrats!

It's fine. It doesn't have any annoying ads, but it's similar to other games. Play a mini game to repair a "house." But gameplay is nothing like how it's advertised, which is ironic considering the ads specifically state the opposite. It also looks like the ad is being reused to advertise for other games that claim the same. So, it seems like a ploy to get you to download. I uninstalled it.

It is funny (not) that in your ad you are complaining about scammy ad-games while being one of them. Yes, your game has nothing to do with the ads. Another thing, if you game has energy mechanics, it is easier to stop playing rather than paying money. There games with same gameplay that doesn't require waiting, your game is not better than them. So, find other monetization mechanics, this one is the worst you could come up with. I played 5 minutes today and already asked to pay.
