The game is interesting; however, in orderto make 1 small task it takes more than 500 energy sparks and the game just gives you 100 daily so you're all the time stuck in the game. There aren't enough rewards to play. So, if you don't want to pay for the game you can only play max 5 minutes daily. So, I consider there's to much to improve in future updates.

Okay, I actually really like this game. I've taken a slow burn approach, and haven't had to drop any of my real money to play it. I enjoy creating the orders, even if it takes a little while, there's always something else to do and once my energy and coins run out, I just either come back later or wait till the next day. Honestly, the only thing that bothers me about it (ergo the four stars, and not five) is the storyline. Honestly people, how many times can one gaslight Quinn? Just help her.

Customer service is a joke, they will cheat you in the end. if you buy anything off of these games, they will eventually take away the free parts of the game. no more ads to get an extra fifteen stamina. no more ads to finish off the last couple of minutes of a box. literally, once you pay once they want all your money all the time and make everything impossible unless you spend a hundred dollars a week. they make it physically impossible to achieve any of the goals without spending money. smdh

This game is nothing like what is advertised. I've let my energy refill a handful of times now, but there's no dilapidated bedroom with rain or snow coming in and you're fixing it as you play the puzzle. It's like the other puzzle games where you're stuck fixing a room in your huge house or a restaurant, and it takes FOREVER to work on 1 room unless you PAY for more energy! There are some puzzles in it, but it's not the sad story that's advertised. Uninstalled.

I hate the new update! When I want to change things in a room, I want to be able to zoom out so I can see the whole room! now, regardless if you zoom out, it zooms back in every time you select a new style, not just a new item! I also think we should get better things when we upgrade where you get the items from. The fact i have a shopping cart for bread and the main thing I still get is a sack of flour is ridiculous. if you want to get anywhere quickly you have to spend money!! SMH

FALSE ADVERTISING. VERY disappointed. lured in by ads where you help a mom and child, but this is just a merge game. have not had any instances that resemble the ads. just merging and rebuilding a cafe. I really just wanted to play a game where I help the woman freezing in the snow but there was zero of that. they'd get a better rating if they just advertised what this game really was. the ads are very misleading, even though they claim otherwise. This company should go make that game. I'd play.

I think my biggest complaint is two items come from one thing. Like the coffee and tea come from the same thing, I can spend lots of energy and get mostly coffee, same with the bread and fries and so on. While the storyline is alright, the darma with the main characters ex can be a little triggering. I like that you can pick what to put in the restaurant, maybe being able to pick what the main character says would also help. Not sure as the player your just watching or really part of things.

Love this game! Get on Everyday! That being said, I cant express this enough! Theres a couple things the game is missing! An undo button, atleast up to 3 times. When my finger slips from the screen or somehow double presses and I click on something I didnt want to click on, I wish to undo it! Another thing that could definitely fix the game just a little! The events!!!!! They're so hard to finish! I'm always so close and then it ends, an extra day on the events would definitely help!

I’m currently at level 98, and the game feels slow and has become an irritation. Orders take too long to complete, rewards are too small, and upgrades are hard to achieve. Renovations cost too many coins, even for small tasks, and there are too many overlapping events. It takes days to finish a single order, with or without spending money and I've spent quite a bit. It's become a money pit!! Feedback from the company is absolutely rubbish and automated responses. In the game: useless!!

I played this game quite a while, and even threw a large bit of money at it. Eventually, I had to quit, due to the "cash grab" mechanic as you level, & the storyline just got silly. Oh - and if you're considering playing the game going by the ads on the Play Store/in other games? They're fake. It's nothing like that. You're helping a gal fix up her restaurant, figure out a mystery, and deal w/her hem-hawing on choosing who of her various sutors to date. As a merge game, it's ok though.

Tired of ad-based rewards that force load Google Play, thereby crashing Gossip Harbor and causing me to lose the reward, instead getting an "sorry, here's 10 energy" for the software's and advertiser's mistake on reload. I figure it's too risky to spend money because of weirdness like this. Caveat emptor. Still doing it. The theoretically free chest of energy pretty much never is. Even when you tap the button to close the ad as quick as possible it gives you an error and force restarts the app

Like their other game, Seaside Escape, this game is 100% pay to play. I'm not above a fun little micro transaction, but paying 10-15 dollars for something that is ultimately unsatisfactory is Not It. The packages you can buy are overpriced, and don't actually help you with your game play. The energy system is brutal - 2 minutes for a single energy when it takes at least 100 energy to complete a single order is FOUL. Do better.

the game if fun. I enjoy the merging and events. im on level 48 or 49. when i log in to play i get less than a minutes worth of play time because even at this high of a level you are still limited to 100 energy. I have been playing for 3 months and can't even upgrade my generators. collecting cards is almost impossible to get all of them. the current round I have completed 1 set and am not even close to getting another set. I play every 2 hours when my energy is full.

Gameplay is simple, however I don't like being drip fed the story. The events are impossible to succeed at without spending money on energy to get one or two moves at a time. The board is constantly full of the pieces of producers, and expanding the ability to store items costs gems which aren't plentiful without spending money. You can watch 2-4 ads for 15 energy while other games give you 25. I'm not impressed, so I've uninstalled.

I really want to like this game. I have been playing for a few weeks now, and I keep noticing that items that I am saving and trying to build up will disappear overnight when I'm sleeping. Today, I lost half of the items on my board while I slept. It honestly makes me not want to play the game anymore because items I spend so much time building up keep disappearing. If it keeps happening, game will be getting uninstalled🫤

It was fun, till it wasn't. I refuse to spend my real money to buy energy. That's manipulative, to have to keep buying over and over to play a game. Nope! I would be willing to pay real money to buy the game and be able to play without the constant ads and limits. It's a shame. Suckering people in to spend what little we have to keep playing a game. Wrong! Just let me buy the game outright and enjoy it. One good thing, only getting a limited number of "energy" keeps me from playing too long. 👎

Really enjoyable game, but unfortunately you need to spend money to progress this game. Every challenge they have, you can never get it completed in time because you run out of energy. 100 energy is way under what you need to complete most foods/objects you need. I have bought the vip pass for the last 2 months and haven't completed it both times because it's near impossible without spending more money. its a money scheme game l, which sucks because I did enjoy the first few weeks.

Good merge game. Quite addictive. But I gave it 3 stars because in app purchase is so pricey compared to Candy Crush. Even the energy took a lot of time to refill. Other items took time to recharge too. Especially special items like the dog cage, spaceship etc. Some items have too many levels to merge, adding the energy bar took time to refill. It's a bit frustrating.

I ended up looking into this because of endless annoying ads on another game.. The game is different from the ads but far more addictive than I was expecting. I also appreciate not having to endure non-stop ads during this game 😉 Edit from one year later: Still enjoying the game but it's hard to play for more than a couple of minutes at a time because you get such limited amounts of energy and as the game progresses, you need more coins to advance the story. It's pricy to keep playing.

I played this game for a while for free and really enjoyed it, especially the events, and figured I would buy an energy pack since I have been playing for so long... But since spending money, I seem to be locked out from watching ads to get the daily energy chest? I'm not sure if this is by design? Edit: confirmed with other players on Reddit that the game locks you out of free items if you spend money! Don't make the same mistake!! Absolutely not spending again unless this changes.

Good game is you have a lot of free time and money. I scored a 3 because of the repetition and need to purchase extra perks to enjoy the game. It's like 5 games in one. The game is a money pit. You have to continuously keep buying diamonds and lightening strikes to be competitive or have fun. For instance I just downloaded this game a week ago and I have already spent $55. Also it will take a week to get a Dalmation. To keep you playing. It's ridiculous.

This game is desperate to use every FOMO and gambling trick in the book. I spent $12 total, and feel like I was dragged into a pool of whales in hopes I could keep up. The amount of money needed to keep up with every hourly drip of almost good enough. Even after paying! Money results in absolutely no progress. The game asks you to wait 4 hours per recharge for an item, and has 5 systems offering to circumvent this in various monetary ways. $8 per charge per item. Makes me sick.

It seems the more you make purchases, the more you have to spend. A good strategy for a child or someone with a child like mind. I reached out to the developer, and no one responded. The game is super fun until you have to wait hours for energy to refill. And even after purchase upon purchase, you still have to wait. Every once in a while, a discount will pop up, but you can not just pick a discount. Updated the discount purchases, and still, this game needs your money to enjoy.

Sorry, the game is ok. The whole game is totally different, I wanted it to be the way the ads were, where you have to choose to fix something because they are getting cold and what not. Now its just a game where you have to choose what type of decor you want for a restaurant and play a mini game for people that wants food and then you need to build puzzles and have limited moves. Supper disappointed

I have contacted the game’s support multiple times regarding ongoing ad errors. The issue is that I’m required to watch ads in order to receive rewards, but after watching them, I get an error message and no reward. This has been happening consistently for weeks. I was advised to reach out to the game directly, but when I did, the response was extremely rude and dismissive of my concerns. I was simply told to “keep watching more ads and eventually it should work,” which is not a resolution

It's fun and has an entertaining story line. I wish they had a faster reset on energy with a larger quantity. Also, 50 gems for each storage slot is ridiculous, considering how many items you need to "spawn" to create the dish and how many bubbles and other extras pop up on the board that's outof our control. You should lower the cost to 10 gems per slot for extra storage. That would make me spend money to buy gems.

Was fun at first. Or so I thought. The orders and the amount of energy required are getting more and more ridiculous. It became frustrating to play. First, the max amount of energy stored is only 100 (when you need a thousand to finish one order 😂). Although there are other ways to earn energy, they only give ridiculously small amounts. Second, you spend coins just for a simple conversation (like whut?). Thirdly, the amount of gems to buy energy is increasing. So bye.

Honestly, the ads for this game do it a great disservice. I don't know why actually good games like this use that stupid false advertising with puzzles that aren't even remotely part of the game. It's a simple match 2 game. It's light and fun with a decent plot. There is nothing to do when you run out of energy, but so long as you have some pocket change lying around you can buy gems for cheap, or simply wait for your energy to recharge and come back later. It's a pretty good game.

I've played over 2 Weeks now and lost interest. You can't progress well unless you pay for gems. Even then they get finished within a few hours. I found myself more annoyed than actually enjoying it. There are too few short wins. Spent more money than what it was worth and left disappointed in end. If you like to gamble this is your game. I'm gonna delete it, the little gains from the massive investment wasn't worth it at all.

Like several other people have started in their reviews, it's fun at first and becomes a pay to win. with energy provided you might get an order completed but take several days to complete a more advanced order with the energy provided, which in turn makes the game less fun. But since the update I just did yesterday, I have not been able to play at all. it starts downloading resources then goes to a black page with hello in the top left. So I will be deleting this instead. I was over level 100..

Still FEELING RIPPED OFF!! **update**After a couple weeks wasting money, I finally realized I had spent 100s on it and was never going to get anywhere. The amount you'd have to spend to progress has to go into the 1000s! You need to do something about this game microfun! Finally deleted!** too expensive. I could have gone out and bought 10 games with full access and no in app extra cost with all the money I spent. I'm still having to wait all the time for two hours to barely play.

I have been playing this for months and actually enjoy it. Considering deleting because its so expensive if you want to play for more than an an hour. starts at 10 gens for 100 merges, then 20, then 40, 80, 160. You can blow through 20.00$ in an hour. Great game but way to expensive and the special games are impossible to beat without spending a ton of money. Probably losing a loyal customer because of this.

The game is nothing like the ads. You won't be patching walls or upgrading anything like the videos show. It is a fun merge game, but the "levels" are just characters talking to one another for a storyline. if you're not willing to spend money on this game, it will take you a loonnggg time to make the orders. I'm confident this game doesn't need adds because players spend a lot of money in game. The amount of energy you have to use vs the energy you get is very unbalanced

After seeing the ad for this game so many times, I got curious. The ad literally said "You know those ads you see with the Mum and Daughter freezing to death and you have to help them? Well this IS that game." It isn't though. This game is just a regular merge game that's pay to win all the way. There's not even snow, it's about rebuilding a restaurant and merging food items to fill orders.

At first I was mad that it wasn't like the ads but now I'm mad at everything else. Aside from the 3-8 ad pop ups you may get when opening the game; the event & even customer orders are never random. The best example is the disco party "random" spin that always gives you the lowest option on the board. The orders are also undervalued, so you can spend a week getting 1 order and get like $24. It gets old fast and has become incredibly boring.

pretty fun, not the most innovative story, but interesting enough. I don't mind spending a bit of money on these types of games. I pay for the VIP reward track if the loot there is worth it. my complaint is that before I spent a dime there were options to watch ads for everything. need a little more energy, watch an ad, watch an ad to pay for a bubble. the moment I spent my first dollar, all options of "watch an ad for loot" completely vanished. never to be seen again. little bait and switch IMO

Decent game. No ads but plenty of ways to speed things up by paying extra. Without paying, it quickly slows to a crawl. The story is okay, but absolutely nothing like the ads. It's less of "Let's help these people in trouble," and more of "Let's fix up this old dump while reading unnecessary drama." Not bad, but not what was advertised, so I will not give it more than 3 stars on principle.

I love this game, it's my favorite and addicting. HOWEVER, I gave only 3 stars because once you reach a certain level you literally can only "play" like 2 minutes before you end up having to wait for your stuff to refill or you spending money. They do come up with fairly cheap ways but at some point the only way to continue is to pay or it just seems like you're wasting time. some people mention ads to earn but I've never seen them and I pay so random my @&&

I'd really like to give this more stars. but I just can't. In short, expontentially: - running out of space - more expensive (in-game cash, gems, and their asking price with real - world money) - running out of energy - harder to fill orders It's so frustrating. I've caved and bought energy, I've had up to 350 energy at once, still wasn't able to fill one order, I'd ALREADY STARTED. Lucky if I get 1 minute playtime. Please devs! Why?

Major cash grab. I have been playing this game for a few months and the investment is significant if you want to complete events. I also have had issues with saved up cards disappearing at the start of the next event without any warning or instruction that this would happen. This is basically the game just stealing from you and they provide no assistance. Customer service is not useful. Other games are more fun and less expensive, so I don't recommend playing. Deleting the game now.

Fell for false ads, thought the game was fun anyways so I invested time into it. I bought the monthly pass and I am extremely upset, because in any game EVER when you buy the pass you are supposed to be able to complete it by simply playing the game. This one is impossible to complete unless you spend money for resources on top of that. I have played it religiously for past month, barely let my energy overcap and it is just not possible. just don't play. ads bug out constantly and don't reward.

The ad made it seem like you'd help a struggling mom and child survive in a rundown home, but the actual game is about fixing up a restaurant with matching puzzles. They get back on their feet almost instantly, and the survival element is barely there. It’s more of a casual renovation game with a light, not-so-rewarding storyline. Not what I expected.

Another game that could be fun, but greed ruins it. So much energy is required to play this game, and it refills so slowly. You can literally deplete all your energy in seconds. Not even worth opening the game. And if you make a single purchase, no matter how small, the few ads for energy will disappear. They say it's random, but that's a lie. It happens the second you spend any money. I guess they think their players are stupid. Now they'll respond claiming it's random.

Particularly annoyed as the ads strongly mis-represented the type of game this is. The game has no storyline puzzles. No player decisions as to fixing the roof, bed, or fireplace first. No option to adopt the girl or not. No clues in the story for the player to make decisions and solve a mystery. This is a very simple matching game to merely earn points to essentially turn the pages of a story book. No, "this is" NOT "that game"

I've been playing this game for a long time. And, it's gotten worse and worse about being a money grab. The new events are terrible. I can complete 7 or 8 orders and not one give points or tools for the events. The only ones that count are orders that either take days using generators to get the items or you have no choice but to spend money to get more and more energy. It's become completely unfair. And, just not fun anymore. All because they've gotten greedy. Time to move on.

This game is like. Mediocre in every way. the story isn't that interesting, the art models look a little lifeless, it takes forever for energy to replenish which makes all the timed events you get feel impossible. the decor is kind of cute and it's nice there's no random pop up ads. Like it's just Okay all around. there's nothing special about this game.

The ad brought me here. I knew it was a load of crock but still decided to try it. You don't get the story advertised and you don't get to make decisions regarding the characters in the game. All you do is merge and sell and the game isn't free like advertised! After a certain stage the energy you need to play becomes unobtainable without you paying for it or watching loads if ads that only give you a limited amount if play time. My recommendation is don't install

I gave the game a shot for a little over a month and honestly, starting off, the game is pretty fun but as you put more time into it, it slows down drastically, which is why I give it Two stars only. The limited time events are designed poorly and you have to spend quite a sum of money if you want to get halfway through some of them. Not to mention how most events make you compete with high spenders for the rewards you would want to get. Overall the game is fun at the start but gets SUPER boring

I saw an ad with a floating brain telling a lady in bed that this game was about saving a woman and child from freezing to death via puzzles. That's not what this game is. It's an okay time-waster otherwise, but I'm sick of these deceptive marketing practices, especially when the ads are so blatant and repetitive with their lies. At least Merge Mansion is honest about what kind of game it's offering.

Its a fine game when filling up idle time but there are certain features that can make one crazy. 1. when trying to open the game, way too many events, daily and side quest announcements pop up. Meaning you have to push x soooo many times before starting to play the game. 2. the energy vs. goal usage is very uneven, the further in you go into the game 3. the game has made many "free" daily gifts that you can get via watching ads, into needing to pay for them with gems. Which is very annoying

Not bad. But unless you spend lots of money it's just too slow to be fun. It's just gets harder and harder doing very basic things. It becomes tedious quickly and there isn't really that sense if achievement in working really hard to make something. You just get a really boring and short chat excerpt. Getting things done takes ages. It seems like a huge game and it would have been fun perhaps but the focus on getting paid is too big. Sell a reasonable subscription plan for unlimited power.

The ads where you hear about how people don't need to spend money in this game? Well, shocker... You do. The false advertising is absolutely astonishing. It the same as all games, you either wait for something to unlock or pay money for gems to unlock it. It's not even worth it. The story line is so boring. Even the advertisement doesn't look anything like the game.

Misleading Game. The game is not like the ad. I have been playing for almost a year and I am ready to uninstall you need money to keep advancing in this game. The energy takes too long to refill, and the higher game levels is impossible to finish any orders because it requires more energy which takes forever to refill. The adventures are impossible to complete as well. Just prepare to spend money if you want to really enjoy the game. The game has potential but greed will prevail as always.

The game is a bit of a fun time killer. Easy to play and not much thought involved. where this game fails is when the orders require an obscene amount of energy and those orders never stop. They consistently stiffle any chance of completing time based objectives and add a layer of complete frustration. Definitely makes it so you have to pay to make any meaningful progress. Comes close to being a very fun game but ends up wasting your time.

This game used to be enjoyable. However, later in the game it seems that they make it harder to achieve goals. And the one time I spent money on a "package deal" of gems, the game gave me none of the items that I needed to finish the challenge when I was so close. And it felt intentional. Needless to say, I will not purchase any more gems for this game and am considering uninstalling. It just seems greedy at this point. They also took away the free daily special treasure box which is now 10 gems

For a merge game, this app is pretty entertaining. The characters are fun, and matching items to level up gets easier once you get the hang of it all. However, so far, this is not a match game in which you match tiles to "help" the characters out of bad scenarios (which was what the advertisement showed). Also, when you are given the option to receive a free item by watching an ad, bare in mind that most of the time, the ad does not load properly, and you do not receive the item.

Good game, good storyline but honestly such a slow pace. Waiting hours and hours to be able to play because you're restricted by energy and you have to merge items a billion times to get the item you actually need. It'd be a lot more enjoyable for me personally if it had levels to beat instead of having the one board and filling "orders" to progress.

The ads for this game make such a huge deal about actually being the game they show in the ads (even with the disclaimer that it unlocks later in the game). However, the gameplay for this is practically identical to their other game, Seaside Escape, and I've been playing for over a week and still haven't seen what they show in the ads. Would've given a better rating if they weren't so misleading.

cute, well-made graphics. A game I would have enjoyed for a long time if the game actually allowed me to play it! Filling orders and progressing in the story is constantly hindered by running out of power, with no option to do anything but wait. The wait is way too long, with very little game play given before you just have to wait again.

I downloaded this game thinking it was the one where they're in a blizzard, but it's definitely not. You can only play a few times a day for a few seconds unless you spend soooo much money. There's no opportunity to earn more energy to play that doesn't involve spending money and progression in the game is SOO SLOW!!!! The game was clearly designed to illicit extreme interest then make it so you can't play unless they're playing. I've been playing a couple week, spent $50+, and only on L26.

This game was fun for awhile. You are given 100 energy, which regenerates at 1 energy every 2 minutes up to 100. The recipes start off low enough that you can merge and provide customers with their meals. However, that does change as you get into the higher levels & now it costs 500 energy to make one dish, but you are only provided the same amount of energy as the beginning. It is completely frustrating for me at this point, and after spending over $300 this month, I'm deleting.

5-star to 1-star... I made a purchase finally...$0.99 for 1000 energy after I opened all levels. Sadly, now that I've made a purchase, the daily energy box you can earn for watching a video option is gone. I can get one for 10 gems and then it's listed a out of stock. If you like this game, don't purchase anything or you're stuck pay-to-play. Prev 5-star: Fun. Not too many double and triple builds [i.e. one thing builds one thing, not two or three things]. Storyline is cute. The kiddo helps.

I used to enjoy this game. I've been playing for months. UNFORTUNATELY you really can't do much unless you want to spend real money in the game. Side games end too soon. and then there's the collecting of cards, etc. Everything reads "'26' days" but is over in less than 10. it's becoming more of a hassle game than a relaxing one. Just about over it

This game is too costly to play. It started out fun but gradually began to costly too much to continue playing. I have an addictive personality I realize and spent over $500 last month. I will have to delete this game. It's truly. ot worth it. The more you spend the bigger your orders. That's not fair. Once you pay 160 diamonds for energy, it should start over and not stay grid locked for 24 hours!

A decently entertaining game that I surprisingly haven't grown bored of after months of playing. I've enjoyed the story, though it took a LONG time for me to like any of the characters (except Sam, he's the GOAT 😌). It's not feasible to complete any of the events in this game without spending $, and even with spending $ it isn't always possible. Energy can be frustrating to manage but still fun to play. Updated rating because this game has joined the many others having ads with fake gameplay.

As you go higher in levels the items become more and more demanding of power that it can take days to finish an order. As levels go higher the amount of base energy should proportionately go up as well. Having 100 base energy isn't even enough to get the higher level items. The only way to accomplish the goals in the higher levels ia to purchase packages.

Great game with fun gameplay and solid graphics. Challenges are engaging, but the timelines are too short. Just today I spent $15 and still couldn’t finish the challenge, which is really frustrating. Unless you buy offers, it's nearly impossible to complete events. It leans heavily toward pay-to-win, which hurts the experience for casual or free players.

The first thing one has to know is that if you are considering installing the game because of the ads, don't. There is literally not one true thing in all the ads for this game, they are all 100% bogus. Other than that, it's a forgettable merge game that runs out of steam and stops being entertaining after several days. You may have some fun in the beginning, but not enough to get hooked, and soon it becomes just pure tedium.

The only thing more annoying than the neverending ads for this game is actually attempting to play it. It's just another merging game, but without the interesting story of some of the others, and with even fewer options for recharging energy. The ads aren't at all representative of the game and you're honestly better off with one of the many other games in this genre.

Takes way too much energy to make the merge items. Side quests are impossible to complete. Easter side challenge for example, you have to use 552 energy to merge items to get 3 rakes. The last challenge they had higher items worth more. You can only play for a few minutes before you're out of energy. Game becomes very repetitive. You don't get more energy with increasing levels.

Downloaded from an ad I saw. Was disappointed that it was nothing like the ad. The ad promised one thing, and the game delivered something completely different. Yes, it is a merge game, just not what was advertised. I'm also confused as to how this has a 4.6 rating when there's nearly triple the one-star reviews as there is 5 star reviews. Played the game for 5 minutes and instantly knew it would end up becoming unplayable real soon, due to the energy cost required to do anything.

Decided to do an experiment and spend even more money this month on certain things. The offers for special packages keep going up each time. The special events are rigged so that you get close but don't win unless you buy an exclusive card package. The game might be fun, but it's a total scam. It's like a skill crane. It's too bad. Deleting now, they proved my point. Spent $100 last month on this game and still couldn't complete the special events.

After you play for a while, the game starts to scam you. For example, I purchased two "surprises" in exchange for 20 gems. I never received the surprises. The game also makes you pay 10 gems for 100 playing tokens. After a while, it then forces you to pay 20 gems for the same 100 tokens, then jumps to 40 gems for 100 tokens! There are other similar problems. It's just a disappointing rip-off.

If you guys don't want to spend real money, move on. Energy runs out too fast, even if you pay it doesn't help much. 1 energy recharges in 2 minutes, and for some items you need 1000+ energy. Takes too long to complete orders wich means at side tasks you don't have a chance completing them cause they are time limited, so rewards offered there are useless since you can't achieve them.

The ads claim that they aren't lying like every other ad and that what is shown is the actual gameplay, but it's yet another lie. The game is nothing like the ads other than that you do merge things to make progress in the story. If you like merge games, then it's fine enough, but if you want to play because of what the ads say, don't bother. Also, I downloaded it from an ad that said I would get $100 worth of in game prizes, but I got nothing of the sort, just what you would typically get.

The rating I gave the game belies how fun it is. Game is fun but to the point where it's almost addictive and that is where I have an issue. When you first start, it's super fun and you make lots of progress so you want to play more but you VERY soon run into a wall where you basically stop making any meaningful progress in the game unless you spend a TONNE of money. Its easy to see the game was actually designed to get as much money out of you as possible. Not free to play friendly at all.

Not like the ads at all. The dialogue and story is a meandering mess that makes little to no sense, with a clear lack of goals or direction. The matching game is severely limited and due to 'energy' restraints requires hours between play sessions. I played for a day but can see how it would take weeks to see any meager amount of progress. Not satisfying in the least.

One of the most annoying things in any game I've ever played is this game essentially just taking all your diamonds from you. You better use them immediately to upgrade the storage for extra items if you don't want them disappearing, all it takes is you not paying attention to your energy running out and boom, you've spent them. They don't ask if you're sure, or anything. It's actually pretty frustrating. Also some orders take multiple irl days to complete, also annoying.

This game is rigged. I was playing a competition, and you're supposed to be playing against other people, but I really feel like I was playing against a bot. It took me literally all day with several boosters, might I add, to get to the level of the competition I was in. Out of nowhere, there was a player that wasn't even in the top 3 is all of a sudden, the leader in less than an hour. There is no way possible those combinations can be completed that fast. I will be deleting and dont recommend.

Enjoyed this game until I couldn't complete a single order in one day because I kept running out of energy. It's not as satisfying when it takes a week to complete an order. Not enough energy and a lot of microtransactions through in-app purchases just to get some more energy. If you want a game to get addicted to and don't mind spending money on this might be for you, but it's too expensive and not satisfying anymore for me. ;/

The game isn't bad & the ads aren't overwhelming, but I noticed that I'm waking up to find some of my items missing. I thought it was all in my mind until this morning. I needed a few more merges to make the final form of the cake, & woke up to find that my previous progress was gone so I have to do it all again. The wait is over an hour to "harvest" the trees & we build 1 energy every 2 minutes to get items needed and there never seems to be enough energy. Now items are disappearing too.

Fun game. Good way to pass time but I have a few grumbles. It takes way too long to clear the board. This could be faster. A few other peeves are the annoying hand pointing(hint) long after I've figured out how to play. It keeps wanting me to spend money to BUY energy. I don't want to waste money that way. No game is perfect but at least there aren't annoying ads....yet.

I really love the game.I love the concept, the colors, the side games. I could play for hours.But unfortunately, it takes 4 minutes to get 1 energy, and then you max out at a hundred energies. So if you've left the game alone for a few hours, you can't get more than 100. in some of the higher level matches, take 200 or more. So it's really annoying, and it makes me want to play other things

I ended up deleting this game and yet I really enjoyed it to begin with. As it took more and more pieces to complete an order I just lost patience. Sometimes you need up to a 1,000 pieces to complete one order. And at 2 minutes wait per charge, I gave up. The times I ended up caving and used in app purchases didn't satisfy me somehow. Anyway, if you ever decide to make the difficulty curve less steep, let me know.

Ads Lie Like many have said the ads are deceptive. it's just a classic merge game that requires energy and has constant events going. Very pushy for pay to play as well as "top ups" which can be cheap but get you no where in the long run. Now if it was like the ads it may be a decent game. I'm a fairly high level with a lot unlocked and far into the story, I have given it the benefit of the doubt.

The game bearsno resemblance to the ads. It's a standard merging game. Nothing outstanding about it. You don't get enough energy to progress quickly enough through the game to complete the challenges and side games. You can buy gems and energy, but they're expensive, and the number of merges you have to make to gain some of the higher level stuff is insane. You can use 600 energy to get one item. if you're not buying energy, this can take days. And nothing changes. same games same merges.

It is a fun game and I really enjoy playing it, but the balance feels unfair as you progress. The more you grow, the more items you unlock, and that means it takes a significant amount of energy to merge items just to get the one you need. Meanwhile, your energy limit stays the same no matter how far you advance. Events sometimes drop extra energy or items, but you usually end up spending far more energy before you get those rewards.

I'm hooked on this game but I deduced stars for everyone else's sake. It's nothing like the ads. At least there are no forced ads though. But everything screams money grab even if the game is free to play. You run out of energy all the time. Some orders take hours to actually complete. Everything is just them asking you for money. All. The. Time. At least the story and characters are nice enough. NOT like the ads though.

It was a lot of fun for a long time, but it has reached a point (Level 133) where I can't really complete anything on time for events without spending a lot of money. I've been perfectly fine spending money regularly, but the amount needed has gotten ridiculous. So I'll stop playing at all. No point "playing" when you are not spending 100+ Euros a month, because you simply won't get any of the events done, which is beyond frustrating.

This game's very misrepresented in the ads. I played for over a year and never saw a single scene showed in the ad. The gameplay was fun enough, but, once I got >Lv 100, the ads started breaking, and I would frequently not be rewarded for what I watched. Add to that the energy consumption gets insane, and there are some orders you need nearly a week's worth of energy for if you don't have boosters stockpiled. Add to that, the story is genuinely bad. Unresolved cliffhangers and sucky characters

It's okay. cute art, but not about a woman in a rundown house who is freezing, no matter what ads say. It's just a gardenscapes merge knock-off. It's too bad. The ads look like more fun, and im disappointed. The game doesn't. even try to present that. You start in a house building a cafe. Plus, when you delete the game, it doesn't delete your progress.

don't believe the ads for this game. it's merely your basic merge game with limited board space and running out of energy quickly. unlike other games of this kind, there isn't even an option to watch an ad to earn extra energy to fulfill the "orders." so I guess the only true thing about the game are that there are no ads but gameplay is about 5-10 mins at a time every few hours. very slow progression and horribly repetitive.

Nothing like the CONSTANT ads. I get ads for this game on every other game I play, so I finally broke down. The basic matching game is fun, but the story is nothing like the ads and is really boring, and it's impossible to keep playing the matching game part for longer than a couple days without having to pay to play, and the game itself is NOT worth paying for. On top of that, there's tons of little add-on side games and quests and bs that's cluttering up the game.

Fun, yet sometimes frustrating. I love the game itself. Most mini games I can participate in to some extent, but as I get higher in levels, it takes hundreds of energy to try and complete the items and when your orders all have high items, it seems like it takes forever to use enough free energy. The other option is to pay for energy or gems. That is the part that is really frustrating

Don't waste your time on this game. It looks fun at the begging and then you have to spend lots of money to get anywhere in the game. It is definitely a pay to play game!!!! Energy takes a long time to regenerate!!! You wait about 3 hours to play a few minutes!!! 100 energy is not enough! You need like 1000 energy to merge items at a higher level. You have to spend money!!! Also side challenges require spending money to complete. Lets face the truth! Waste of money for nothing 😒

Honestly, don't bother with this game. It's fun for the first few days, but like many others said, the orders get so complicated that they take DAYS to complete. The energy limit remains at 100, even at higher levels, at which point it's not even enough to complete one simple order. You have to wait like 3 hours for your energy to refill, then you get to play for 1 minute if you're lucky. Don't spend your time or money on this game. There are better options out there made by less greedy devs.

Let me preface this by saying I really love the early levels of this game. Great system, great progression, but like all other add free games you hit the paywall HARD with this game. After only a week of playing it takes multiple full energy to fill a single order or two if you're really lucky. Events are useless as you can't complete enough orders to get far into them. I bought a few in app purchases but it's now to the point where if you don't buy energy you can't play the game.

Fun game, a lot of different elements to win rewards and progress in the game. I really wish for the option to watch ads to earn coins or lightning to make more matches in the kitchen. No one likes to watch ads but I always do in other games and I'll never spend my money on these types of games. So I'll have to stop playing once I max out what I can do. Also, it's not at all like its ad- that fixer upper by making matches, which made me want to install it in the first place. it's similar though!

I've been playing this game for a year now and am at level 104. I've also made several purchases for gems and energy that I could say is at least a few hundred dollars. The game is fun, and the side events add a little more to do when you're out of energy. Having said that, I'm considering deleting the app after so long. It does get pretty expensive to play because 100 energy doesn't go far the more you level up. There's no option for watching ads either. Asking for improvement so I don't delete

REALLY slow game, honestly from the very get-go you have to use 100 energy for one or two orders for a sign. It's not a 'story' game, it's constant, nonstop merging that feels like it gets you nowhere. I seen the ads and KNEW it would have false advertisement, but I atleast tried for the merging and it's not rewarding enough to make me want to play any longer than 10 minutes.

Game is rigged to cost you $$$ to play. Game is fun but the longer you play the more difficult it gets to actually complete anything without paying. At this point (I've played a few weeks) it is pretty near impossible, and has gotten boring. Also, once you start paying the prices keep going up; packages that started at $3-7 are now $20+. I have stopped purchasing and will likely delete the game soon. *LMAO at response. In other words, we don't care about turnover, always someone else to burn

I loved playing this game! I was at a VERY high level & had to pay money to get there. I had to uninstall the game due to the money. They only give 100 energy at a time to fill orders. It goes quickly in less than 10 minutes. Then you have to wait hours for it to build back up to be able to play again. There are no ads to watch to get more energy or gems. That is unless you spend money like I did. I put alot of time & money within this game. I just couldn't do it anymore. Please make changes!

I understand that the creators want to make money on their game, but the amount of money I've spent on this game is ridiculous. You have to constantly get your energy up in order to make 2 orders at a time...at least that much. The art is fantastic, and the story is entertaining, but the gameplay is frustrating, annoying, and based solely on making a boatload of money selling energy (if you don't buy it, you will stagnate in the game) to the game player.

I really enjoyed the game and I have spent real money because I was invested. The game at one point was fun and rewarding. However, among other things, having a daily goal star taken away for “not doing enough” was extremely discouraging and, well, my breaking point. When progress can be reversed despite time and money spent, it makes goals feel unreachable and effort feel wasted. The progression system ends up feeling punishing rather than rewarding for long-term players. I've uninstalled it.

Fun game, and I love the no ads. However, the waiting time for the power regeneration takes way too long. I spend less than 5 min of playing time, and I barely accomplish much, then I have to wait an hour+ to be able to play again. After a while, it gets too frustrating.I will delete the game, which is unfortunate, because it's actually fun if it wasn't for all the waiting. I understand that's their way of motivating ppl to spend money, but not everyone can or want to spend money.

I'll start off by saying the ads are a complete lie, the gameplay shown does not exist. it's a shame they use the now standard tactic of lying about what the game is because it is solid, the company seems to have 0 confidence in the game. be aware that the game slows down drastically as you progress. I am at a point where completing a single order takes days if not several worth of energy, and the game is clearly designed to frustrate you into spending money 1 ⭐ out of principle for false ads

First : no matter what the ads say, this game has nothing to do with the poor mom and her kid freezing in a cold broken house. Anyway, I ended up playing for a while because the story was interesting. You could merge and relax for a bit and then go back to the story and make it progress quite a bit before having to go merge again. But it is really a pay to play kind of game. I gave the max I think makes sense for a game and had to uninstall in the middle of the story.

Like all of these "free" games, there comes a point where you start losing the ability to play only by using the free rewards. The levels become more difficult and you run out of coins, points, stars, etc. It isn't fun to lose the level because you don't have the resources to continue playing. You have a choice: continue to lose, delete the game, or buy resources to continue to play. Not much of a choice.

I like gossip harbor as I've been playing for a year, but their current ads are straight up a lie. If they didn't lie, I would give them a 4.5. But don't lie to your customers. They are what make you money, no? It's just a straight-up merge game, and it's fun with decorating, but I dont like wasting time on story or chores. And there is no change up between merging categories, but I think they hit it spot on with their add-on pricing. The best I've seen, actually.

This is annoying. I've seen so many different ads for this game. a large number saying this game is the ad. is it? 5%. the gameplay is somewhat like but you don't get to choose like in the ad. same story? 2%. building repair involved. completely different vibe. and rather than help and save them, this is a damned romcom or boss chick with romance plot. i really wish someone sued for false marketing. or teach me how. I'm near annoyed enough to give it a shot

I downloaded this game just to be able to leave a review. I have no interest in playing the game, but the ads suck! That toxic so called "Boss" is so annoying, I almost broke my phone. The ads say that no money is required yet 2 seconds later, the boss offers you 100$ worth of goodies. Tell your marketing team they can do better. And for the love of God, remove that jackass from the ads!

Game starts fun then gets boring. In the beginning it is fun and you can accomplish things and finish goals. Now that I have been playing for a bit all my tasks have a maxed component that is hard to get. I am on day three and still didn't have enough to get an item. The side games are pointless because at this rate I will never finish them. With no chance of completing the side goals there is no point playing.

The gameplay is extremely boring, nothing like the ads with the mom and kid in the snow, the ads are a lie. All you do is follow the story but to even progress you just do a mini game over and over again where you tap the shopping cart a thousand times (wasting your energies) and matching endlessly until eventually you get the desired product. It's not a fun gameplay at all and honestly super disappointing.

This is probably my new favorite game, and it has made me stop playing all other games on my phone. However, the game sets you up to only win challenges if you make a purchase for more energy or gems. So if you never make a purchase you'll never win any challenges and that sucks. Also, in terms of what they are trying to sell, it's never worth the price. I don't recommend buying anything.

It's a nice game, but if you are looking for an engaging time waster this is not it. Progress is very slow, you rarely have anything to do for longer than 15-30 minutes and then you wait for hours for energy to refill or generators to refresh. Some items take actual weeks to make. There are optional purchases that make the game more engaging but for me it's not worth it.

it's a standard merge and build game. you have limited energy unless you want to pay to play. it is advertised as "the game the way the ads actually portray" where you select the window or bed to save them from the snow storm ect but in reality it's just another merge & story game. game itself is standard. I gave it a 3 star rate for false advertisement.

Downloaded this game because I wanted to see if really WAS like the ad showed. Of course it wasn't. BUT. It is super fun and there's plenty of challenges and an intriguing storyline to keep me coming back! I'm going to say it's probably one of my favorite mobile games so far! Honestly, we didn't need the "starving" mom and child ad--showing the real game probably would've lured me in too. There's food, mystery, and fun events. I recommend giving this game a shot! I'm addicted!

I really like this game. While I'm a fan of the genre, Gossip Harbor is a standout. With lots of events and enough features to keep me coming back for more. I can't award 5 stars for one reason and one alone, and it's the same thing that threatens to persuade me to uninstall--my generators average around Level 6 or so and I keep getting orders for max-level items. This really sucks because I have to spend two days or so ONLY working on these items. It's ridiculous and sucks all the fun out.

This was fun at first but recently it's so draining. As you reach higher levels (I'm at level 35), the orders are more difficult to complete but the energy level kept being 100 at max just like the beginning. Then what's the point of reaching higher levels? I've even spent money to help me complete some challenges but that's it. This game ain't worth it anymore

I like the game, but I am starting to lose interest. Max of 100 energy while not in play. You get 1 energy every 2 minutes. It's getting to the point where some of the items can take days to make. I do not play while working or sleeping. I have been off for two weeks and have played this game way too much trying to do things. I think the max energy should be by level/day completed. more to say, just outta space and energy!

Installed the game for only two reasons. First, to complain about the misleading, and very long, and very annoying ads I keep being forced to watch while playing games I actually want to play. And second, I installed it, opened it, and uninstalled it, and now Google won't show me your ANNOYING AD FULL OF LIES ANYMORE! At least for a while. I'll enjoy not seeing your face for a long as possible. I am SO SICK of ads not representing the game for what it is!

Simple gameplay loop that is fun and addictive, and compelling story. However, events have a short time limit that often cannot be cleared even if you play across entire off days, and even if you spend money to advance more quickly. It's not a huge amount, but it still feels like players are not set up for success even if they do pay when time is your main opponent. "Better luck next time" feels disrespectful to the player's time and effort. Long story short, try it out but don't put money in.

The game isn't entertaining and gets repetitive very quickly. The story is not very interesting, and it's obvious that the whole point of the story and gameplay is to get the player to spend money on energy and other power ups. It feels more like a game developed to constantly squeeze its players for money than to deliver the players an enjoyable experience. I played it for an hour and now I'm uninstalling it. PS The ads with the mother and daughter in the snowstorm are not relevant to the game

The gameplay is fun and definitely addicting, but that's the whole point. No ads, but energy takes forever to recharge on its own or you could spend real world money to make things faster and easier. I was also really hoping to help a homeless family in the cold snow, but it's not that at all. Just merging food and random things for restaurant orders. Also super slow story and I hate the husband UGH. gonna look for a different game that's easier to play for free

I downloaded this game based on the ads claiming that the game is ad free and wont cost a penny, plus the game is supposed to be true to the ads. Lies, all complete lies. It should be illegal to lie this much. The game costs too much to enjoy the game fully. You can't advance unless you pay for additional perks. I miss the games of the past where you purchase the game and aren't forced to spend money to advance in the game. Game developers these days are greedy and dishonest.

It was not the storyline they show in the ads and instead of just merging to get what you need, you have to fill out orders and make bread. honestly it's a good game without ads, just not the story they advertise. there's also a problem with energy so you can really only do so much in a day and as I'm told the bigger the level the higher the energy required so it becomes near unplayable at some point I'm sure. Overall, it's a decent game

Very addictive but dependent on paying for merge points the higher you advance. You only get 100 points merge points which refresh with time. This starts out ok, you enjoy the game, get addicted, but by the time you're at level 50+, that 100 points lasts about 2 minutes of play time and you either have to pay for more points or wait a few hours for the merge points to refresh. No ads, so there is no free option to renew points quicker. I uninstalled the game to avoid spending more money.

I uninstalled because this game is pay to win. You only get about 5 minutes of game play every few hours. The game is skewed to be as difficult as possible. Certain items are random and will become LESS likely to be received when you need them. You lose the ability to get the blue energy for free every day once you make an in app purchase. It would be a good game - if it weren't so obvious how overly manipulated the mechanics are to make you pay.

All you guys out there who plan on playing this game be well aware not to make any purchases because once you make it (like I did just one single time) everything will go downhill. I am truly disappointed because the basic settings have completely changed after this. I have lost all the perks and bonuses as well as an ability to gain any additional energy through advertising. Consequently, I have lost my entire progress! In short, I am truly pissed! 😡😡😡

I would suggest to never spend money on this game. Their customer service is useless and doesn't care to correct things. They make your card pack disappear and don't add an alert when the season ends and when you message them about it they say too bad you should have remembered the alert from 40 days before. They could easily put a reminder in the game at season end if they actually cared.

Fun and well-designed, but clearly pay-to-play. Energy stays at 100 no matter your level, and buying more gets pricier each time. Items to complete orders are expensive compared to the tiny gem rewards (e.g., 165 vs. 10). Even leveling up doesn’t renew energy—only waiting or paying does. Great game, but built to make you spend.

The game isn't free as advertised and there is no free pack as advertised either. Downloaded and deleted after 30 minutes of useless, mindless matching and reading a silly but predictable storyline...one line at a time. Not to mention the pictures displayed in the ad are not even available in the game. It's just another merge game that you WILL need to buy packs for unless you have hours to wait for energy refills and "daily gifts" that aren't useful in progressing past level 5.

Enjoyed playing this game until I spent money. All of my "watch ad" rewards were all removed after my first purchase. I contacted support and they mentioned that ad rewards are assigned at random. After reading online, this issue has happened to all players that spent money. The game has slowed down so much since I don't get the reward benefits anymore. At the end of the day they will still make money from people viewing ads. Unfortunately, I uninstalled and just wanted to warn other players.

It starts off with 100 gems that get used up in mins. Gems are essential for gameplay. It takes 1 min to earn 1 gem, so that's over 1.5 hours to refill your gems. You can buy gems, but this game that advertises that you don't need to spend money. So basically, you play for 2- 5 minutes, then do something else for an hour or so. Repeat the cycle. I can't get into a game in 5 minute intervals over several hours. I honestly don't understand all the 5 star reviews.

It's definitely nothing like the ads. I wanted this story line and mini games but it's all fake to get your attention. However, once you start playing, it does become fun to play and you want to try to make as many orders and fulfill the game as much as possible. I did end up loving the game to a certain extent. I wish you accumulate lives faster and make the merging less to fulfill more orders.

I've been playing for 2 years, and it's excellent, but it can get expensive. Whatever psychology is spent here works, lol... I've spent maybe $800 on this game, and that's the only downside. It's almost impossible to win all the challenges without energy, and it takes a long time to generate it organically. That said.. It's amazing otherwise. Edited, it's nearly impossible to merge needed items without a purchase. A whole life of 100 is not enough...

I recently re-installed this because I couldn't remember why I uninstalled. as soon as it finally downloaded the assets (it froze at 100% downloaded) and I restarted the app, I was bombarded by unskippable tutorials for about 10 different events going on. I am so annoyed I don't even care about trying to get back into the story again, which is what drew me back. immediately uninstalling.

It's pretty fun for the first day or two.. after that, the board becomes very crowded with random items you cant merge or sell yet, and you spend 150 energy points trying to get one dumb fancy cup of coffee and not even reach it. it becomes very unbalanced very quickly if you don't spend real money. I miss the days when you just bought a mobile game and that was that.

cool game concept but they make it extremely difficult to upgrade anything and every match you do takes absolutely forever to get to the correct item. I like where this type of game can go, but in order to complete an order that requires an advanced item takes forever to do. been playing for a couple weeks now and still can't get certain items upgraded.

The aggressive marketing campaign for this game is driving me up the wall. Other aps force me to watch this game's 4 minute ad about the sad lady in the snow with her freezing kids 10 times in a row. I feel manipulated and it's so bad that it has turned me off to ever wanting to play this game, which I might otherwise be interested in. Seriously, it's not cute, it's just annoying. Especially knowing the game and its story won't actually look like the stupid ads.

Definitely not the game where you get the mom and daughter out of the freezing cold. But it does have an intriguing storyline nonetheless. The amount of energy they allow you is fun for a couple of levels, but after a while it becomes more of a pay to play than a pay to win. You end up logging in for 3 minutes of play and then have to wait 3 hours just to rinse and repeat. And the side stories they come up with only drain your energy reserves faster. Instead of being a mini game to gain more.

I like the game but the ads for Mistplay are faulty, they just sit there and I have to exit out of the game and instead of being rewarded the 15 stamina I watched the ad for I get "oops! this ad failed, here's 10 stamina". I've learned to exit immediately without watching the ad and receive the same reward but it would be nice if it were to function properly. When this is fixed I will 5 star.

So much false advertizing. Claims to have no purchases ->bombards you with things you can buy like a gacha game, and slows down progress unless you pay. Clails to have a 100€ welcome gift. Said gift is a battlepass that gives you gems you can buy for 2€ in the first hour.... and you can pay to get the "gifts" faster. And dont get me started on the "gameplay" ads. The gameplay in the ad is not what the main game is about. Its a f-in shop running merge game

If you're patient, you really don't need to spend any money. You do need a lot to complete orders but you can usually just play a little, plan a little (only collect the gems and coins once you've merged to full) and if you really want, just check in more often. Overall it's a cute and relaxing game to either check in quickly as little or as many times as you want during the day/whenever to use up the energy.

Cute game to spend free time, but items disappear sometimes and I am using the 2× points and items that are worth 1 will take 2 points. The system should know the difference if we use this feature. I recommend if these items are fixed. Game doesn't get harder, just a lot more expensive to play the game. Losing interest. Takes a very long time to build up for many items.

All energy gets used to make just one item on the list, takes to long to get the story going and that makes me loose interest in the game, plus I'm so far in the game and not once did I get to play the side mission games as it was advertised. This game doesn't have the games with the lady and child that needs windows and beds and so on repaired, as they say this game really has!!!! Very disappointed

The ads for this game are completely deceptive and fake. Even when they claim "This is the game that is exactly like the ads", it is a lie. The game is nothing like the ads, it is a merge game and the story is about serving food at a cafeteria. The game is rigged so that if you pay, you have to pay more and there is definitely not "uninterrupted gameplay" like the fake CEO promises in the ad, you can play for a few minutes each time, then you have to pay for energy. No $100 worth of gifts either

love the game. it's good that it has no "unsolicited pop up ads." but as someone who played a lot of games it'll be actually nice if we have an option to view an ad just to get more energy and coins (and i mean not just a one-time 15 energy per day? lol). it's so frustrating how i have to wait hours for my energy to refill. i seriously would rather watch tons of ads than to purchase with real moneyーi still give u money without spending money. it's a win-win.

update: I had a free chest and as soon as I went to cluck on it, it changed to costing 10 rubies. Not sure what's going on with this game anymore. at level 81 and am deleting it. Did they stop giving out the 2 free chests a day? It really makes it harder to play and get energy. You can only play a short time and then have to wait for the energy to refill ( which takes forever). Really Thinking about uninstalling. Fun game just wish there were more options for experience and energy.

I really love this game...but you just can't progress without spending a LOT of money. You can't get very far because everything takes so many steps to merge to the items you need and you run out of energy and it takes forever to regenerate unless you purchase it with gems...and you see where this is going. I had to delete because even though I'm usually really disciplined about spending on games, I spent over $100 in a month on this without realizing it.

The idea of the game is fun and I enjoy playing it. But, only giving 2 stars because it takes WAY too long for things to 're-energize.' It also takes way too long for 'lives' to do the same. There aren't enough rewards given gor extra/unlimited lives. You can only purchase if you want extra play time. So, generally I get to play for 5-10 minutes then have to stop for three hours before everything regenerates to play again for the same amount of time. Will delete if nothing changes next update.

The ads for this game are just downright lies. It's fine as a merge game, but these ads are absurd. One had a girl, live, speaking to a cartoon character in bed (???), she literally says it IS the game in the ad... But it's not... Why isnt this considered false advertisement? It's very dishonest. It feels almost as if they are mocking us with an ad that acknowledges how frustrating it is to download a game from an ad only for it to not be the actual game... I won't play it on principle.

Warning!! This game lies,Steals & Cheats. If you do spend money on it, which you have to do to get anywhere you will have unauthorised debits on your account the things you purchase will penalise you in the end and thats if they dont disappear between plays. Points change & when you get onto support you will get their standard, "We are sorry for your bad experience". You will not get any help!! First game i have ever had to report for doing these things. VERY GREEDY DEVELOPERS. Avoid!!!

I have spent over #50,000 playing this game and what I discovered is a total waste of time and resources. They gave you 100 moves to sort for one order with 700 moves. Do u kno how many days it will take you without purchasing? At least we need like 1000 moves for every refresh and lots of goodies to make the game more fun. It's a game not a bet company. We don't av to pay before we'll enjoy the game. If there's no changes. I may be forced to delete the game from my phone in a week time.

Despite the game not looking like the ads at all, it's one of the best games I've ever downloaded, it's the first time I didn't regret downloading a game I found in an ad. To be honest I can't even wait to get home after school to play it, however there are a few disadvantages. I've clicked the link in the ad to download the app yet haven't gotten the promised gems, energy... + it's frustrating how low I always am on energy, a little help please?

Yes, it is a meeting game but not that addictive. Yes, it does have the story line, but you have to read it and there's no 3D characters like the ads. Personally, I like the gameplay more than the ads just promote it. Actually, they're not that poor and they have their own restaurant. The graphic in the game is more pleasent than in the ads. No icky pain and stuff.

Deleted. Takes forever to level up producers without paying to play. The number of pieces needed to level up anything is huge and takes up a ton of room on the board. Some producers have 2 or more different items, such as coffee and tea, and it costs 100s upon 100s of energy. Lastly, if you're playing a side game and time runs out, it won't let you finish even though you started before time is up. I was 2 seconds away from getting bonuses and it took the game away with no warning.

Game crashes/reboots way too often! On my Lenovo tablet, I watch ads in order to get "rewards" (i.e.: energy, boxes of extras), and after the ads have played, the game either crashes, or reboots, and I get a message, "Oops! The ad failed to load. Here's 10 energy." It's not so bad when I'm trying to get 15 energy (I only lose out on 5), but when it's something more substantial, it's starting to get VERY ANNOYING!

I really enjoy this game, but I've been playing for several weeks and I receive less energy every day in the daily boxes. today's box had 4 purple bottles...16 energy. when orders take 200-500 energy to make, 16 is infuriating....which pushes you into buying energy. I have never spent money in an app before, but have now. will probably delete, can't afford $5/day

Update: They claim ads are random. Check the subreddit, everyone there agrees the ads for bonuses went away after they spent money, myself included. --Like this game quite a bit. Absolutely nothing like the weird ads. Warning, if you put ANY money into this game you can no longer watch ads for bonuses. Also it's a huge cash grab, the prices for things fluctuate and you will never have enough to finish any events. Only play if you're casually into merge games, don't spend money.

You either have to spend money or play constantly to complete the events. Limited-time packages will cost different depending on how you spend but include the same stuff for all players. A new player might pay 1.99, a player who spends occasionally will pay 5.99, a player who spends a lot will be charged 9.99. So its really just penalizing the big spenders. Main character sucks but unlocking the rooms and the little mini games were fun.

Had it for like...5 days and I was sick of it. It's okay, but definitely not the best merge game. If you want to do renovation stuff, just get sunny house instead. There's way too many times where you pay coins to pass a level and it's just them talking. Also there's like a million events which is kinda fun because it does help you progress but kind of annoying when you just wanna play the actual merge/do level part. Also the energy takes forever which of course is a common issue with merges

the game is kinds fun, but absolutely NOTHING like the ads suggest. as long as you pay money to get energy (or purchase gems to get more energy) then you can keep playing and have a lot of fun. ... but keep in mind energy accumulates super slow and spends super fast!! but there are no ads in this game, I would rather have ads to accumulate more play time without spending USD!

this game does not have what it show in advertisement. I have played this game and the characters do not go through hardships and if they do its in a very high level not at the beginning. in the beginning you are doing merging to redecorate everything. My opinion is this game waste time with weak merging or "puzzles" it a joke... I look to play what I see advertised not to get the run around.

fun until it isn't. there will be a point that 100 energy isn't enough. very hard to continue without spending money when you hit that point. you need more energy as the story progresses. there are times I can't fulfill orders for days due to the limit. yeah you get 25 free energy daily from their social media site, but it's not enough. there needs to be an overhaul, or more energy when you hit certain levels. don't even start this game. if you're curious about the story, find it online.

When you can actually play the game it's pretty fun. But you can only play for about 5-10 minutes, then you have to wait an hour or so to recharge. The 5-10 minutes of play to 1 hour of waiting cycle got pretty boring, so I ended up uninstalling the game. I wouldn't be opposed to paying for power ups, but you would burn through those pretty quick and then you would be right back to waiting again. I really think the Devs need to tweak the timers or provide more ways to get energy.

I loved this game in the beginning, But as you progress, the items get ridiculously expensive and you are constantly prompted to spend money for rubies and energy s to help you progress through the game. The plot moves along at a snail's pace and the main character, Quinn, is not likeable. She is wishy washy and indecisive, constantly suspecting her friends who do nothing but support her, and she mainly ignores her daughter who she claims to adore. It was fun at first and I spent money $$$.

Upgrading gift packs disappear after the countdown timer. I saved my red pack to be able to merge to the larger pack. It had a 20 min countdown timer, so I put my phone down and played another game while waiting. After returning to the game, upgraded box disappeared. I know I didn't use it because I wasn't able to open anything, and my board reflected this. I reached out to customer service only to be told that I opened and used it. No help and no restoration.

This game is pretty fun. Nothing like the ads, but I prefer the game it actually is. The story is interesting, the characters are fun, and I love the queer representation in the game. However, as a lot of people have already stated, the slow speed of energy regeneration is pretty off-putting. And I personally have a problem with the use of generative AI for a couple of their ads. It feels lazy, which isn't what this game is. Overall, pretty good.

I'd give it a 5 star but the almost impossibility of gaining gems is just annoying. You have to either buy it or wait till you find it in a treasure box, and you need it to generate energy. It makes me want to delete the game. I mean you could give it a timer to generate some like you've done with the energy(which is super slow by the way) or opt watch ads to get more or play games to get more. It's just annoying that there's no way to earn some. Great game, but I think I'll be deleting it soon.

I would give this game a (- 5 ) if I could. (It's designed for pay to play) It's not free! energy runs out far to soon, takes hours to recharge so filling orders become impossible & frustrating. if you do pay to play your energy will run out just as quickly because filling orders will take more & more energy, each time you fill an order the next will cost more so you always have to buy more to play. a lot of work, a lot of frustration, for very little reward. not a fun game

I originally just got this for mistplay points. I enjoy merging and i love the story. I would give this 5 stars, but it's getting expensive to play. I don't mind paying a little once in awhile if I really enjoy a game, but I keep spending money and everything is gone in under 10 min because the merges are costly and the energy cap is way too low for what is required as the game goes on. I'm at level 25 and it's getting too costly. Please fix this and I will change to 5 stars. Thanks.

It's a great game, but I do feel that the rewards, are not quite rewarding. The chests, daily rewards, task rewards, they should be something that players look forward to to keep making players to be addicted to collect those rewards and keep playing. But what I'm experiencing is quite the opposite. And it is so hard to refill those energy, took 2 minutes per energy, while other games took only 30 secs or 1 minutes. Overall, its a fun game, but the rewards are quite disappointing. Great work!

Pretty fun app. My only complaints are that the energy cap should be higher than 100, especially since boosters were introduced, especially x4. It's obvious they want us to spend money, but sometimes the "deals" don't make much sense. Also false advertising in some apps. I thought this was a different game. Obviously i still play it for now.

CAUTION-THIS GAME IS A GAMBLE 1. you are not helping a mother and child living on the streets. you're rebuilding a business. 2. you are only given 100 moves but items needed to progress through the game require more than 100 moves to create. 3. ALL purchases are time limited - if you do not complete the tasks in the time given, you lose what you paid for and because you need more than 100 moves, you are guaranteed to lose unless you buy more moves. you only get 1 move restored every 2 minutes.

Really cute game but costly! If you are not willing to sink alot of money into this game, you will get to play about 5 minutes. Then you run out of energy and it takes forever to come back. It only regenerates 100 energy every 200 minutes or so. And most of the coins you collect are spent to hear the story, not fixing or upgrading the building and such. I think you should give better rewards especially energy for completing tasks and increase the energy base to about 500 energy to start.

Hi, The game is super fun at the beginning. But after 30 days, the orders are too complex to finish and also the energy is not enough to finish even one order most of the times unless you buy energy continuously. So the game is structured to make you frustrated so that you end up spending money everyday or login every 3 hours just to complete simple orders and achieve the challenges. The game should be modified to accommodate these issues otherwise people will delete it eventually.

I don't really feel like the types of puzzles match the ad. I give it some stars for being a decently designed game, and I didn't feel too pressured to spend money.
