But there is still some pressure and I found the ad misleading. the puzzles you do in game are purely a classic matching game with no "save the mom and daughter by picking the right action" element like the ad has. disappointing.

Fun game, but crashes a lot. Requires a *ton* of patience due to the crashing. Edit after interacting with customer service: reduced to one star, as no solutions were presented except purchasing another device. All requests for additional information required being able to interact with an app that won't stay running for more than a few seconds at a time. Will be deleting, and would not recommend.

I've never wanted to pay for booster packs or stuff like that for a game ever BUT, this genuinely got me invested. So yeah, now I just paid for a bunch of gems to keep recharging energy Lol. My only suggestion would be to update or change the pictures from the page and show off a bit more in the ads because it feels misleading and suspicious at first, you don't feel 100% sure you won't be scammed by what's shown to you and what the real gameplay is like. Outside of that, good job devs.

Cool game, but I really hate that the energy chest that used to cost an ad, now costs 10 gems. It also sucks that the energy limit that you can accumulate is only 100 and that it takes over 3 hours to accumulate in the first place. The ratio of the energy you can accumulate and the amount needed for higher ranking orders just doesn't add up. Will probably delete it soon since it's become less fun and more stressful because of this.

Without making in-game purchases it doesn't play great. When I started I thought this game was awesome, after a while the free stuff they give you so you can purchase energy and can actualy play the game, goes away. I started purchasing so much stuff just to get the same feeling. After a while I started to feel that this game was a monthly financial drain and I stoped. I have played for a month now with no purchases... it is slow and time draining game with good graphics.

Game is good. Don't believe these ads they are in no way how this game is, unless these are late stage game levels(which I doubt). Orders are easy at first, timed events are fair, then you get to where I am and it takes hundreds of energies to get part of 1 order done(looking at you shellfish net and storage bin). Don't get me started on having to click through events that I don't want to participate in(looking at you "racing" events. The flower event is garbage as well).

I spent about $600 on this within 8 months. Regrets of course. but it's very addicting. Uninstalling now since I'm at the point of the game where it takes about 300 to 500 energies just to finish 1 order.. and I eventually got infuriated. 3 stars only because it really did entertain me for a couple of months. and It'll be hypocrisy giving it lower when I spent so much lol. It is my fault for expecting to be rewarded though. but yeah. fair warning: it does not get better.

I really enjoy this game, but the limited energy of 100 and the lack of ways to replenish it are frustrating. It’s making me consider reinstalling the game, as I can’t play for long periods. A possible solution could be increasing the energy limit or providing more energy when leveling up. This change would keep players engaged and prevent them from uninstalling before fully enjoying the game. I hope the developers consider this feedback.

Finally uninstalled the game. The greed from the developers was the main driving force. How does a 100 energies cost 10- 80 diamonds for the same amount? When you make a mistake and make one inapp purchase you kiss freebies goodbye (so much for loyalty to people who are willing to spend money)... and some items in these orders are just ridiculously expensive... I won't even talk about the false advertising when this game kept popping up as an ad while playing other games. nxa.

Very addictive, and very stingy with play points (energy) so you have to "pay to play" essentially unless you want to have 5 minutes of game play followed by 3 hours waiting for recharge and repeat. They do this on purpose and the algorithm knows when you are hooked so they start increasing costs to ridiculous amounts. This isn't a few $1.99 purchases, it's $15-$30 for a couple hours of game play.

It's quite a fun game to pass time. I'd rate it 5 stars but the absolute bum rush of constant pop ups and nonstop changing and flood of mini games takes away from the normal game. While I enjoy some of the mini games others are just flat out annoying and disruptive. Edit: The pop ups and mini games have completely over taken the game and have ruined the fun of the game. I just want to play the game not 4 or 5 mini games I care nothing about. I shouldn't have to close out 7-10 pop ups at start!

Money Hungry, this game is fun when you spend the money but a grind when you don't. many games I have played you can complete a tournament if you put in the time but this only if you put in the money. it gets almost impossible if you don't drop some $$$$$ New review: I think i am quitting that game truly money. spent countless hours and about $20 on an event to get bonus on an event and still ended without about to complete and win. This is crazy. if you ready to dish out money go ahead

Horrible Customer Service.. on 5 different occasions, I tried to watch the commercials to get the free energy chests. The game freezes and the commercials do not play. This causes you to lose the free chests. You then have to wait another 24 hrs to try again. I tried on several occasions to connect with customer service, they told me to restart the game or clear the cache which literally does nothing... After over a week of back and forth they said they don't give credit even for a system error.

Extremely predatory with dark designs and behavioural nudges to get you to always spend. At first, it may seem like an innocent story-based puzzle game, but there is zero puzzle element to it and the story is painfully bad. When you get further in the game, the order randomizer gives you the most difficult orders to complete all the time. It is coupled by urgency from events that end too quickly. Keep your kids away. This is a dopamine-filled behavioural trap. Gameplay is not fair

The commercial says this game is THAT GAME. But it's just another merge game that charges you to get ahead once the story starts to get interesting. Plus, the story isn't the one from those commercials where you fix the bed and fireplace and window. I just want to fix the doggone window from the commercial! I'm extremely unsatisfied and frustrated.

after several months of use the verdict. don't play. it's a money grabber. many aspects of the game have no value. each character gives you a gift and each has 30 levels, which is pointless. you don't get more or more gifts from them the higher you go. I played the mini games alone because the rest of the players were bots or didn't exist at all.

Very cute game. I don't really understand the desire to directly copy Love & Pies and Merge Mansion event mechanics; surely it's not that hard to come up with new ideas. The story is fun - I'm not far along enough to have seen the bugs others have seen post-update I guess. The music is also really great. I would love to see more chances to get a bubbled item by watching an ad. It happens very rarely.

It's Alright - It's not "that game" as the ad with the used car salesman states, it's a normal basic merge and renovate game. Once you're up in levels, you can't finish an order without spending money because there isn't enough energy in one day to fill it as they are multiple orders requiring very high level merged ingredients. So if you want to participate in the competitions and get anywhere or collect the prizes, you have to spend money. typical cash grab engineering. 🙄

Somewhat disappointing. It is a very short playing experience every 3.3 hours. you can only earn 100 energy unless you win some or buy it. The recipes that are ordered, require several levels to create them, with each level requiring at least 4 energy up to a total of 16, doubled (32 energy). As you can see, you burn through 100 energy quickly. It is very obvious why this is the 2nd highest $ grossing game. The ad graphics are completely misleading. I want a game I can spend time playing longer.

Well, I was enjoying this, then the issues started. I downloaded the update to fix the issues, then ended up with 2 apps. I deleted the old one and I play on the new one and now anytime I watch the video for the free energy, I get an error message that the ad failed to load (after watching the full ad) and get "rewarded" with 10 energy. It's a mindless free game to fill time, so I guess I shouldn't really complain but, the fixes have just created new issues.

Story and variety of mini games are good. However the energy drains too quick, and restores too slowly. Also uninstalled & installed the game back to reset things and start over, but it put me back where I was stuck before. It could have been more relaxing if we could just keep playing without thinking about energy drain. Uninstalling again.

I think my review was removed... The game is mix of a soap opera mystery and merge game. I actually like the story line and characters introduced have some pretty good development. Downside happens once to get further in the game. Merges require items, and to produce match items you need energy. And some of the merge combinations required take a lot of energy to pull off. I really feel like it's an addictive pay to play type game.

This game, it starts off great. However. at level 16, it starts to charge extra for everything. You might have 20 energy, but you're only getting 7 things. It becomes aggravating and not worth the time or effort around this level. Even when you meet all your goals, you still are gonna be too broke or charged too much it's not worth the play or time you have to go back to finish your orders. Which is sad. it's your best one! You actually get to choose what your place looks like.

I loved this game at first, but now I think I might uninstall this it even though I spend money on it. I'm level 41 and it's taking hundreds of energy to make one single item (it's been like this for a few levels now) Ya know, maybe you'd get more if you gave more, like, when someone levels up, give them some energy (that increases more with each level, too) nobody is gonna keep spending all this money if they're not getting anything in return...do better!!

Game would've been more enjoyable if you could play it for more than a few minutes at a time. 1 energy takes two minures to refill and then the max energy only goes upto 100! Trust me, this gets depleted in minutes! Even after you upgrade your production items, they still mostly produce the base level items which you have to merge to improve. It sucks because the rewards you get decrease as you progress through the game, forcing you to either spend money on the game or only play a few minutes.
